687bd432df0c950001145eb3.organization_short_description:
Strategy, formerly known as MicroStrategy, is a publicly traded American company founded in 1989 and headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia. The company specializes in cloud-native, AI-powered enterprise analytics software and is recognized as the world's first and largest Bitcoin Treasury company among publicly traded business intelligence firms. It trades on NASDAQ under the ticker MSTR and reported approximately $463 million in revenue for fiscal year 2024.

The core offering of Strategy is its enterprise analytics software platform, which features universal semantic layering, AI and business intelligence capabilities, and cloud-native deployment. Recent product launches include Strategy Mosaic™, an AI-driven data management tool, and Strategy One™, an automated analytics platform. In addition to software, Strategy has accumulated over 423,650 bitcoins as part of its treasury strategy, providing investors with unique economic exposure to Bitcoin. The company serves a diverse range of global customers across various industries, focusing on enhancing strategic decision-making through advanced analytics and data visualization.

60c758c8d8197b00012b6f10.organization_short_description:
Welcome to Future Electronics! We are a worldwide leader in electronic components distribution and are recognized as one of the most innovative companies in the industry.

Are you ready for your next challenge? Our growing teams are always looking for driven, hardworking people to join us. At Future Electronics, we pride ourselves on being an employer of choice. This means a stimulating work environment where opportunities and growth are always within reach. Leaders who care about your success and colleagues who share common goals. To learn more about what it's like working with us, take a look at our Life pages.

Our people fuel our mission. Our enthusiasm, innovation, and drive to succeed are what make us a global powerhouse in electronic component distribution. With an entrepreneurial spirit and a can-do attitude, we are always up for the challenge. We strive to solve whatever problems are in front of us - for our customers and our suppliers.

Become part of a +$35 billion business: check out our job postings to find your next role.

Bienvenue chez Future Electronics!
Nous sommes un leader mondial dans la distribution de composants électroniques et sommes reconnus comme l'une des entreprises les plus innovantes de l'industrie.

Êtes-vous prêt(e) pour votre prochain défi ? Nos équipes en pleine croissance sont toujours à la recherche de personnes motivées et travaillantes pour se joindre à nous. Chez Future Electronics, nous sommes fiers d'être un employeur de choix. Cela signifie un environnement de travail stimulant où les opportunités et l'évolution professionnelle sont toujours à portée de main. Des leaders qui se soucient de votre réussite et des collègues qui partagent des objectifs communs. 

Faites partie d'une entreprise de plus de 35 milliards de dollars : consultez nos offres d'emploi pour trouver votre prochain poste.

66f9552d9901a20001a86096.organization_short_description:
Welcome to Future Electronics! We are a worldwide leader in electronic components distribution and are recognized as one of the most innovative companies in the industry.

Are you ready for your next challenge? Our growing teams are always looking for driven, hardworking people to join us. At Future Electronics, we pride ourselves on being an employer of choice. This means a stimulating work environment where opportunities and growth are always within reach. Leaders who care about your success and colleagues who share common goals. To learn more about what it's like working with us, take a look at our Life pages.

Our people fuel our mission. Our enthusiasm, innovation, and drive to succeed are what make us a global powerhouse in electronic component distribution. With an entrepreneurial spirit and a can-do attitude, we are always up for the challenge. We strive to solve whatever problems are in front of us - for our customers and our suppliers.

Become part of a +$35 billion business: check out our job postings to find your next role.

Bienvenue chez Future Electronics!
Nous sommes un leader mondial dans la distribution de composants électroniques et sommes reconnus comme l'une des entreprises les plus innovantes de l'industrie.

Êtes-vous prêt(e) pour votre prochain défi ? Nos équipes en pleine croissance sont toujours à la recherche de personnes motivées et travaillantes pour se joindre à nous. Chez Future Electronics, nous sommes fiers d'être un employeur de choix. Cela signifie un environnement de travail stimulant où les opportunités et l'évolution professionnelle sont toujours à portée de main. Des leaders qui se soucient de votre réussite et des collègues qui partagent des objectifs communs. 

Faites partie d'une entreprise de plus de 35 milliards de dollars : consultez nos offres d'emploi pour trouver votre prochain poste.

5b9b347bf874f7c8869cb3b2.organization_short_description:
TIBCO Software Inc. is a global enterprise software company that specializes in real-time data integration, analytics, business optimization, and process automation. Founded in 1985, TIBCO has established itself as a leader in the industry, operating as a business unit of Cloud Software Group. The company is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with a significant presence worldwide, employing over 4,000 people and serving more than 4,000 enterprise customers across various sectors, including healthcare, financial services, telecommunications, and government.

TIBCO offers a range of software solutions designed for high performance and scalability. Its key offerings include TIBCO Cloud Integration for seamless data connectivity, TIBCO Data Science for advanced analytics and machine learning, and tools for process automation and business optimization. The company is recognized for its innovative approach, exemplified by its "Two-Second Advantage®," which helps organizations capture and act on critical information swiftly. TIBCO's commitment to real-time data technologies empowers enterprises to make informed decisions and drive operational efficiency.

63ce978d0f146c000171af9d.organization_short_description:
Strategy, formerly known as MicroStrategy, is a publicly traded American company founded in 1989 and headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia. The company specializes in cloud-native, AI-powered enterprise analytics software and is recognized as the world's first and largest Bitcoin Treasury company among publicly traded business intelligence firms. It trades on NASDAQ under the ticker MSTR and reported approximately $463 million in revenue for fiscal year 2024.

The core offering of Strategy is its enterprise analytics software platform, which features universal semantic layering, AI and business intelligence capabilities, and cloud-native deployment. Recent product launches include Strategy Mosaic™, an AI-driven data management tool, and Strategy One™, an automated analytics platform. In addition to software, Strategy has accumulated over 423,650 bitcoins as part of its treasury strategy, providing investors with unique economic exposure to Bitcoin. The company serves a diverse range of global customers across various industries, focusing on enhancing strategic decision-making through advanced analytics and data visualization.

54a7d17774686965d93ae552.organization_short_description:
Welcome to Future Electronics! We are a worldwide leader in electronic components distribution and are recognized as one of the most innovative companies in the industry.

Are you ready for your next challenge? Our growing teams are always looking for driven, hardworking people to join us. At Future Electronics, we pride ourselves on being an employer of choice. This means a stimulating work environment where opportunities and growth are always within reach. Leaders who care about your success and colleagues who share common goals. To learn more about what it's like working with us, take a look at our Life pages.

Our people fuel our mission. Our enthusiasm, innovation, and drive to succeed are what make us a global powerhouse in electronic component distribution. With an entrepreneurial spirit and a can-do attitude, we are always up for the challenge. We strive to solve whatever problems are in front of us - for our customers and our suppliers.

Become part of a +$35 billion business: check out our job postings to find your next role.

Bienvenue chez Future Electronics!
Nous sommes un leader mondial dans la distribution de composants électroniques et sommes reconnus comme l'une des entreprises les plus innovantes de l'industrie.

Êtes-vous prêt(e) pour votre prochain défi ? Nos équipes en pleine croissance sont toujours à la recherche de personnes motivées et travaillantes pour se joindre à nous. Chez Future Electronics, nous sommes fiers d'être un employeur de choix. Cela signifie un environnement de travail stimulant où les opportunités et l'évolution professionnelle sont toujours à portée de main. Des leaders qui se soucient de votre réussite et des collègues qui partagent des objectifs communs. 

Faites partie d'une entreprise de plus de 35 milliards de dollars : consultez nos offres d'emploi pour trouver votre prochain poste.

66fd9adaedbef400010ebb6f.organization_short_description:
Strategy, formerly known as MicroStrategy, is a publicly traded American company founded in 1989 and headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia. The company specializes in cloud-native, AI-powered enterprise analytics software and is recognized as the world's first and largest Bitcoin Treasury company among publicly traded business intelligence firms. It trades on NASDAQ under the ticker MSTR and reported approximately $463 million in revenue for fiscal year 2024.

The core offering of Strategy is its enterprise analytics software platform, which features universal semantic layering, AI and business intelligence capabilities, and cloud-native deployment. Recent product launches include Strategy Mosaic™, an AI-driven data management tool, and Strategy One™, an automated analytics platform. In addition to software, Strategy has accumulated over 423,650 bitcoins as part of its treasury strategy, providing investors with unique economic exposure to Bitcoin. The company serves a diverse range of global customers across various industries, focusing on enhancing strategic decision-making through advanced analytics and data visualization.

60cb2c94010d090001b1465d.organization_short_description:
Vox Media is a prominent American mass media company founded in 2003 and headquartered in Washington, D.C., and New York City. The company focuses on community-driven journalism and explanatory journalism, which simplifies complex topics. Vox Media operates a diverse portfolio of nearly 20 influential editorial brands, including The Verge, Vox, SB Nation, Eater, and New York Magazine, among others. 

The company also boasts one of the largest podcast networks in the U.S., producing popular shows like Pivot, Criminal, and Today Explained. Vox Media attracts over 160 million audiences monthly, catering to fan-centric communities and general consumers interested in technology, sports, food, gaming, politics, and lifestyle. With approximately 1,900 employees, Vox Media continues to set trends and ignite conversations in modern media.

681db4a691270500010009d3.organization_short_description:
Group Bayport is a global leader in the custom-product industry, specializing in over 10,000 personalized products. Founded in 2007 in Atlanta, Georgia, by Nishant Shah, the company has expanded to include more than 1,450 employees across six countries, including the US, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, and India. Group Bayport operates under the legal names Avaan International, Inc. in the US and Caterpillar Signs Private Limited in India.

The company offers a diverse range of products through three main segments: signages and displays, custom covers and tarps, and home decor and apparel. Their product lineup includes banners, portable displays, outdoor living covers, and eclectic home décor items. Group Bayport serves a B2B2C market, catering to small businesses, trade show exhibitors, and individual consumers seeking personalized solutions. With a focus on innovation and technology, the company aims to lead the custom product category globally.

587a70bef651252f3a3b6d37.organization_short_description:
Vox Media is a prominent American mass media company founded in 2003 and headquartered in Washington, D.C., and New York City. The company focuses on community-driven journalism and explanatory journalism, which simplifies complex topics. Vox Media operates a diverse portfolio of nearly 20 influential editorial brands, including The Verge, Vox, SB Nation, Eater, and New York Magazine, among others. 

The company also boasts one of the largest podcast networks in the U.S., producing popular shows like Pivot, Criminal, and Today Explained. Vox Media attracts over 160 million audiences monthly, catering to fan-centric communities and general consumers interested in technology, sports, food, gaming, politics, and lifestyle. With approximately 1,900 employees, Vox Media continues to set trends and ignite conversations in modern media.

602aafecca986f0001ba1df3.organization_short_description:
Welcome to Future Electronics! We are a worldwide leader in electronic components distribution and are recognized as one of the most innovative companies in the industry.

Are you ready for your next challenge? Our growing teams are always looking for driven, hardworking people to join us. At Future Electronics, we pride ourselves on being an employer of choice. This means a stimulating work environment where opportunities and growth are always within reach. Leaders who care about your success and colleagues who share common goals. To learn more about what it's like working with us, take a look at our Life pages.

Our people fuel our mission. Our enthusiasm, innovation, and drive to succeed are what make us a global powerhouse in electronic component distribution. With an entrepreneurial spirit and a can-do attitude, we are always up for the challenge. We strive to solve whatever problems are in front of us - for our customers and our suppliers.

Become part of a +$35 billion business: check out our job postings to find your next role.

Bienvenue chez Future Electronics!
Nous sommes un leader mondial dans la distribution de composants électroniques et sommes reconnus comme l'une des entreprises les plus innovantes de l'industrie.

Êtes-vous prêt(e) pour votre prochain défi ? Nos équipes en pleine croissance sont toujours à la recherche de personnes motivées et travaillantes pour se joindre à nous. Chez Future Electronics, nous sommes fiers d'être un employeur de choix. Cela signifie un environnement de travail stimulant où les opportunités et l'évolution professionnelle sont toujours à portée de main. Des leaders qui se soucient de votre réussite et des collègues qui partagent des objectifs communs. 

Faites partie d'une entreprise de plus de 35 milliards de dollars : consultez nos offres d'emploi pour trouver votre prochain poste.

5913acba9d7968e50805c4e1.organization_short_description:
Capital Health is a nonprofit healthcare system based in Trenton, New Jersey, recognized for its commitment to quality patient care. It operates two hospitals: Capital Health Regional Medical Center, a Level II trauma center and comprehensive stroke center, and Capital Health Medical Center in Hopewell. The system also includes an outpatient facility, various primary and specialty care practices, and a satellite emergency department.

With over 100 years of service, Capital Health employs around 3,400 professionals and generates significant annual revenue. The organization is accredited by The Joint Commission and DNV and has received multiple Magnet® designations for nursing excellence. Capital Health offers a wide range of services, including acute and trauma care, perinatal and neonatal care, specialty services in areas like oncology and heart health, and comprehensive women’s health. It also features unique pediatric emergency services, including New Jersey's first autism-friendly pediatric emergency department, emphasizing its dedication to community health and well-being.

60bdcbdf233b690001f329db.organization_short_description:
Strategy, formerly known as MicroStrategy, is a publicly traded American company founded in 1989 and headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia. The company specializes in cloud-native, AI-powered enterprise analytics software and is recognized as the world's first and largest Bitcoin Treasury company among publicly traded business intelligence firms. It trades on NASDAQ under the ticker MSTR and reported approximately $463 million in revenue for fiscal year 2024.

The core offering of Strategy is its enterprise analytics software platform, which features universal semantic layering, AI and business intelligence capabilities, and cloud-native deployment. Recent product launches include Strategy Mosaic™, an AI-driven data management tool, and Strategy One™, an automated analytics platform. In addition to software, Strategy has accumulated over 423,650 bitcoins as part of its treasury strategy, providing investors with unique economic exposure to Bitcoin. The company serves a diverse range of global customers across various industries, focusing on enhancing strategic decision-making through advanced analytics and data visualization.

610bbbc846c4790001c567ff.organization_short_description:
Vox Media is a prominent American mass media company founded in 2003 and headquartered in Washington, D.C., and New York City. The company focuses on community-driven journalism and explanatory journalism, which simplifies complex topics. Vox Media operates a diverse portfolio of nearly 20 influential editorial brands, including The Verge, Vox, SB Nation, Eater, and New York Magazine, among others. 

The company also boasts one of the largest podcast networks in the U.S., producing popular shows like Pivot, Criminal, and Today Explained. Vox Media attracts over 160 million audiences monthly, catering to fan-centric communities and general consumers interested in technology, sports, food, gaming, politics, and lifestyle. With approximately 1,900 employees, Vox Media continues to set trends and ignite conversations in modern media.

5570aa4273696421dbaa3000.organization_short_description:
Hopebridge Autism Therapy Centers is a healthcare provider focused on delivering comprehensive therapy services for children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) and related challenges. Founded in 2005, the company has expanded from a single center in Kokomo, Indiana, to over 120 centers across 12 U.S. states. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, Hopebridge employs between 1,000 and 5,000 professionals dedicated to providing individualized care.

The center offers a range of services, including Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA), Occupational Therapy (OT), Speech and Language Therapy, Feeding and Swallowing Therapy, and Physical Therapy. Each child receives a tailored therapy plan based on thorough assessments. Hopebridge also emphasizes family involvement through training programs that help parents implement therapeutic strategies at home. The organization is committed to evidence-based practices and reducing wait times for diagnostic evaluations, ensuring that children receive the support they need.

6728afb34ab7420001ab35e8.organization_short_description:
Hopebridge Autism Therapy Centers is a healthcare provider focused on delivering comprehensive therapy services for children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) and related challenges. Founded in 2005, the company has expanded from a single center in Kokomo, Indiana, to over 120 centers across 12 U.S. states. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, Hopebridge employs between 1,000 and 5,000 professionals dedicated to providing individualized care.

The center offers a range of services, including Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA), Occupational Therapy (OT), Speech and Language Therapy, Feeding and Swallowing Therapy, and Physical Therapy. Each child receives a tailored therapy plan based on thorough assessments. Hopebridge also emphasizes family involvement through training programs that help parents implement therapeutic strategies at home. The organization is committed to evidence-based practices and reducing wait times for diagnostic evaluations, ensuring that children receive the support they need.

668b7c4045a2b3000137e5a3.organization_short_description:
Give and Go Prepared Foods is a prominent Canadian manufacturer of fully-finished, premium sweet baked goods. As a subsidiary of Mondelēz International since 2020, the company specializes in a variety of products, including brownies, cookie decorating kits, and mini treats. Their offerings cater to four main consumer occasions: Celebration Solutions, Breakfast Solutions, Everyday Treats, and Better For You Snacking.

The company markets its products under several well-known brands, such as two-bite® for mini brownies and Create-A-Treat® for cookie decorating kits. Give and Go operates seven production facilities in the Greater Toronto Area and one in Shirley, New York, supplying leading retailers and food service operators across North America. They focus on innovation in product development, driven by consumer research and a deep understanding of their retail partners' needs.

6114697b3cb76f0001e31a43.organization_short_description:
Newfold Digital is a prominent web technology and web presence solutions provider, catering to approximately 6.7 to 7 million customers globally, primarily small-to-medium-sized businesses (SMBs). Established in February 2021, the company is a joint venture between Clearlake Capital and Siris Capital, combining the strengths of Endurance Web Presence and Web.com Group. Headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida, Newfold Digital employs around 4,300 to 5,000 people and is recognized as the third-largest player in the global web presence market, generating over $1 billion in annual revenue.

The company offers a wide range of digital services, including web hosting, domain registration, website builders, SEO, online marketing, and e-commerce development. Newfold Digital supports over 80 brands, including well-known names like Bluehost, HostGator, and Web.com. Their mission focuses on providing personalized support and extensive product offerings to help businesses establish and enhance their online presence, serving a diverse customer base across North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, and South America.

60f9732b9aa6050001fc9e14.organization_short_description:
Newfold Digital is a prominent web technology and web presence solutions provider, catering to approximately 6.7 to 7 million customers globally, primarily small-to-medium-sized businesses (SMBs). Established in February 2021, the company is a joint venture between Clearlake Capital and Siris Capital, combining the strengths of Endurance Web Presence and Web.com Group. Headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida, Newfold Digital employs around 4,300 to 5,000 people and is recognized as the third-largest player in the global web presence market, generating over $1 billion in annual revenue.

The company offers a wide range of digital services, including web hosting, domain registration, website builders, SEO, online marketing, and e-commerce development. Newfold Digital supports over 80 brands, including well-known names like Bluehost, HostGator, and Web.com. Their mission focuses on providing personalized support and extensive product offerings to help businesses establish and enhance their online presence, serving a diverse customer base across North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, and South America.

675060016e3b2a0001ef195a.organization_short_description:
Newfold Digital is a prominent web technology and web presence solutions provider, catering to approximately 6.7 to 7 million customers globally, primarily small-to-medium-sized businesses (SMBs). Established in February 2021, the company is a joint venture between Clearlake Capital and Siris Capital, combining the strengths of Endurance Web Presence and Web.com Group. Headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida, Newfold Digital employs around 4,300 to 5,000 people and is recognized as the third-largest player in the global web presence market, generating over $1 billion in annual revenue.

The company offers a wide range of digital services, including web hosting, domain registration, website builders, SEO, online marketing, and e-commerce development. Newfold Digital supports over 80 brands, including well-known names like Bluehost, HostGator, and Web.com. Their mission focuses on providing personalized support and extensive product offerings to help businesses establish and enhance their online presence, serving a diverse customer base across North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, and South America.

60f83684953afa0001723692.organization_short_description:
Give and Go Prepared Foods is a prominent Canadian manufacturer of fully-finished, premium sweet baked goods. As a subsidiary of Mondelēz International since 2020, the company specializes in a variety of products, including brownies, cookie decorating kits, and mini treats. Their offerings cater to four main consumer occasions: Celebration Solutions, Breakfast Solutions, Everyday Treats, and Better For You Snacking.

The company markets its products under several well-known brands, such as two-bite® for mini brownies and Create-A-Treat® for cookie decorating kits. Give and Go operates seven production facilities in the Greater Toronto Area and one in Shirley, New York, supplying leading retailers and food service operators across North America. They focus on innovation in product development, driven by consumer research and a deep understanding of their retail partners' needs.

54a525487468692abf5daa80.organization_short_description:
Give and Go Prepared Foods is a prominent Canadian manufacturer of fully-finished, premium sweet baked goods. As a subsidiary of Mondelēz International since 2020, the company specializes in a variety of products, including brownies, cookie decorating kits, and mini treats. Their offerings cater to four main consumer occasions: Celebration Solutions, Breakfast Solutions, Everyday Treats, and Better For You Snacking.

The company markets its products under several well-known brands, such as two-bite® for mini brownies and Create-A-Treat® for cookie decorating kits. Give and Go operates seven production facilities in the Greater Toronto Area and one in Shirley, New York, supplying leading retailers and food service operators across North America. They focus on innovation in product development, driven by consumer research and a deep understanding of their retail partners' needs.

60eefdb18cb32d00016e092e.organization_short_description:
Wolters Kluwer N.V. is a global professional information services company based in Alphen aan den Rijn, the Netherlands. Founded in 1836, it operates in over 180 countries and employs approximately 21,100 to 21,700 people. The company generated around €5.9 billion in revenue in 2024, with a significant portion coming from North America and Europe.

Wolters Kluwer provides a range of expert solutions and workflow tools across five main divisions: Health, Tax & Accounting, Financial Corporate Compliance, Legal & Regulatory, and Corporate Performance & ESG. Key offerings include UpToDate for clinical decision support, CCH Axcess Suite for tax and accounting, and TeamMate for audit management. The company focuses on delivering accurate, real-time information to professionals in healthcare, finance, legal, and compliance sectors, helping them make informed decisions and enhance productivity.

6769210b89ff400001abd760.organization_short_description:
Toyo Tires is a leading multinational manufacturer of high-performance automotive tires and rubber products, headquartered in Itami City, Japan. Established in 1945, the company operates in over 100 countries and regions, with eight manufacturing facilities across Asia, North America, and Europe. Toyo Tires ranks as the 11th largest tire company in the world by revenue, reporting net sales of 497 billion Japanese yen in fiscal year 2022.

The company specializes in a wide range of tire products, including passenger car tires, light truck and SUV tires, commercial truck tires, and off-road specialty tires. Toyo also manufactures various automotive components, such as rubber parts and industrial materials. With a strong focus on research and development, Toyo Tires employs advanced technology to enhance tire performance and safety. The company serves individual consumers, commercial fleet operators, and automotive industry partners, ensuring a diverse customer base across global markets.

66fd2e5a6d51660001be431e.organization_short_description:
Wolters Kluwer N.V. is a global professional information services company based in Alphen aan den Rijn, the Netherlands. Founded in 1836, it operates in over 180 countries and employs approximately 21,100 to 21,700 people. The company generated around €5.9 billion in revenue in 2024, with a significant portion coming from North America and Europe.

Wolters Kluwer provides a range of expert solutions and workflow tools across five main divisions: Health, Tax & Accounting, Financial Corporate Compliance, Legal & Regulatory, and Corporate Performance & ESG. Key offerings include UpToDate for clinical decision support, CCH Axcess Suite for tax and accounting, and TeamMate for audit management. The company focuses on delivering accurate, real-time information to professionals in healthcare, finance, legal, and compliance sectors, helping them make informed decisions and enhance productivity.

60e59f7e4c41be00017f3bbc.organization_short_description:
Wolters Kluwer N.V. is a global professional information services company based in Alphen aan den Rijn, the Netherlands. Founded in 1836, it operates in over 180 countries and employs approximately 21,100 to 21,700 people. The company generated around €5.9 billion in revenue in 2024, with a significant portion coming from North America and Europe.

Wolters Kluwer provides a range of expert solutions and workflow tools across five main divisions: Health, Tax & Accounting, Financial Corporate Compliance, Legal & Regulatory, and Corporate Performance & ESG. Key offerings include UpToDate for clinical decision support, CCH Axcess Suite for tax and accounting, and TeamMate for audit management. The company focuses on delivering accurate, real-time information to professionals in healthcare, finance, legal, and compliance sectors, helping them make informed decisions and enhance productivity.

680dd60e6b7ef4000171498c.organization_short_description:
Toyo Tires is a leading multinational manufacturer of high-performance automotive tires and rubber products, headquartered in Itami City, Japan. Established in 1945, the company operates in over 100 countries and regions, with eight manufacturing facilities across Asia, North America, and Europe. Toyo Tires ranks as the 11th largest tire company in the world by revenue, reporting net sales of 497 billion Japanese yen in fiscal year 2022.

The company specializes in a wide range of tire products, including passenger car tires, light truck and SUV tires, commercial truck tires, and off-road specialty tires. Toyo also manufactures various automotive components, such as rubber parts and industrial materials. With a strong focus on research and development, Toyo Tires employs advanced technology to enhance tire performance and safety. The company serves individual consumers, commercial fleet operators, and automotive industry partners, ensuring a diverse customer base across global markets.

5d0dc4c2f3e5bb8345a41a48.organization_short_description:
Draper, officially known as The Charles Stark Draper Laboratory, Inc., is an independent nonprofit engineering innovation company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Founded in 1933, Draper focuses on designing, developing, and deploying advanced technology solutions to tackle global challenges in national defense, space exploration, health care, and energy. The organization became independent from MIT in 1973 and has since established itself as a leader in various engineering fields.

Draper offers a range of services across four primary areas: biotechnology systems, electronic systems, strategic systems, and space systems. Their expertise extends to human systems, cyber solutions, and autonomous systems, providing engineering services primarily to government agencies, private sector partners, and academic institutions. With approximately 2,000 employees and a revenue of $765 million in fiscal year 2023, Draper collaborates with various consortia to address complex national issues.

5ac36a55a6da98155575c3cb.organization_short_description:
Toyo Tires is a leading multinational manufacturer of high-performance automotive tires and rubber products, headquartered in Itami City, Japan. Established in 1945, the company operates in over 100 countries and regions, with eight manufacturing facilities across Asia, North America, and Europe. Toyo Tires ranks as the 11th largest tire company in the world by revenue, reporting net sales of 497 billion Japanese yen in fiscal year 2022.

The company specializes in a wide range of tire products, including passenger car tires, light truck and SUV tires, commercial truck tires, and off-road specialty tires. Toyo also manufactures various automotive components, such as rubber parts and industrial materials. With a strong focus on research and development, Toyo Tires employs advanced technology to enhance tire performance and safety. The company serves individual consumers, commercial fleet operators, and automotive industry partners, ensuring a diverse customer base across global markets.

66f50a3d7b91830001e7c2b6.organization_short_description:
Wolters Kluwer N.V. is a global professional information services company based in Alphen aan den Rijn, the Netherlands. Founded in 1836, it operates in over 180 countries and employs approximately 21,100 to 21,700 people. The company generated around €5.9 billion in revenue in 2024, with a significant portion coming from North America and Europe.

Wolters Kluwer provides a range of expert solutions and workflow tools across five main divisions: Health, Tax & Accounting, Financial Corporate Compliance, Legal & Regulatory, and Corporate Performance & ESG. Key offerings include UpToDate for clinical decision support, CCH Axcess Suite for tax and accounting, and TeamMate for audit management. The company focuses on delivering accurate, real-time information to professionals in healthcare, finance, legal, and compliance sectors, helping them make informed decisions and enhance productivity.

637eb68dc06373000199ef09.organization_short_description:
Draper, officially known as The Charles Stark Draper Laboratory, Inc., is an independent nonprofit engineering innovation company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Founded in 1933, Draper focuses on designing, developing, and deploying advanced technology solutions to tackle global challenges in national defense, space exploration, health care, and energy. The organization became independent from MIT in 1973 and has since established itself as a leader in various engineering fields.

Draper offers a range of services across four primary areas: biotechnology systems, electronic systems, strategic systems, and space systems. Their expertise extends to human systems, cyber solutions, and autonomous systems, providing engineering services primarily to government agencies, private sector partners, and academic institutions. With approximately 2,000 employees and a revenue of $765 million in fiscal year 2023, Draper collaborates with various consortia to address complex national issues.

610ab3b614a266000172a692.organization_short_description:
Mosaic is a not-for-profit healthcare organization focused on empowering individuals with diverse needs to lead full and independent lives. Established in 1921, Mosaic operates across 13 states in the U.S. and serves over 750 communities. With a dedicated team of more than 3,000 professionals and nearly 2,000 independent contractors, the organization supports approximately 4,500 to 5,000 individuals each year.

Mosaic offers a wide range of person-centered services, including supported living arrangements, day programs for community integration, behavioral and mental health support, and senior care services. The organization emphasizes inclusivity and community engagement, providing tailored support for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities, mental health needs, and aging adults. Mosaic's mission is rooted in compassion and empowerment, ensuring that every individual has the opportunity to thrive within their community.

5d2d4d6ff65125a3a94b5f9e.organization_short_description:
Electronics for Imaging, Inc. (EFI) is a global technology company based in Fremont, California, with operations in ten countries, including the United States, India, and Spain. Founded in 1989, EFI specializes in industrial inkjet printing, digital front ends, and comprehensive business and production workflow software. The company is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the ticker symbol EFII and has a workforce of approximately 1,300 to 3,400 employees.

EFI offers a wide range of services, including digital production workflow solutions, consulting, training, and a global support network. Its product portfolio features various industrial inkjet printers, advanced inks, and workflow software designed to enhance productivity and efficiency across multiple industries, such as packaging, signage, textiles, and ceramics. EFI is committed to sustainability and customer success, focusing on reducing waste and energy consumption while promoting innovative digital imaging solutions.

6001d5abe82d0300014ffccc.organization_short_description:
Mosaic is a not-for-profit healthcare organization focused on empowering individuals with diverse needs to lead full and independent lives. Established in 1921, Mosaic operates across 13 states in the U.S. and serves over 750 communities. With a dedicated team of more than 3,000 professionals and nearly 2,000 independent contractors, the organization supports approximately 4,500 to 5,000 individuals each year.

Mosaic offers a wide range of person-centered services, including supported living arrangements, day programs for community integration, behavioral and mental health support, and senior care services. The organization emphasizes inclusivity and community engagement, providing tailored support for individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities, mental health needs, and aging adults. Mosaic's mission is rooted in compassion and empowerment, ensuring that every individual has the opportunity to thrive within their community.

63a5e151226a5f0001197499.organization_short_description:
Electronics for Imaging, Inc. (EFI) is a global technology company based in Fremont, California, with operations in ten countries, including the United States, India, and Spain. Founded in 1989, EFI specializes in industrial inkjet printing, digital front ends, and comprehensive business and production workflow software. The company is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the ticker symbol EFII and has a workforce of approximately 1,300 to 3,400 employees.

EFI offers a wide range of services, including digital production workflow solutions, consulting, training, and a global support network. 67d3d804c271d900012bd9cf.organization_short_description:
Electronics for Imaging, Inc. (EFI) is a global technology company based in Fremont, California, with operations in ten countries, including the United States, India, and Spain. Founded in 1989, EFI specializes in industrial inkjet printing, digital front ends, and comprehensive business and production workflow software. The company is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the ticker symbol EFII and has a workforce of approximately 1,300 to 3,400 employees.

EFI offers a wide range of services, including digital production workflow solutions, consulting, training, and a global support network. Its product portfolio features various industrial inkjet printers, advanced inks, and workflow software designed to enhance productivity and efficiency across multiple industries, such as packaging, signage, textiles, and ceramics. EFI is committed to sustainability and customer success, focusing on reducing waste and energy consumption while promoting innovative digital imaging solutions.

60954ea7fe07040001c85e4c.organization_short_description:
Eskenazi Health is a prominent public hospital system serving Marion County and Central Indiana. With a history spanning over 165 years, it is dedicated to providing high-quality, patient-focused care. The system operates as the public hospital division of the Health & Hospital Corporation of Marion County and collaborates closely with the Indiana University School of Medicine. Its main facility, the Sidney & Lois Eskenazi Hospital, features 315 beds and handles over 1 million outpatient visits each year.

The organization offers a wide range of healthcare services, including primary and specialty care, emergency medicine, trauma care, burn care, behavioral health services, surgical procedures, telehealth, and diagnostic imaging. Eskenazi Health also operates a network of community health centers throughout Indianapolis, ensuring access to care for vulnerable and underserved populations. As a nonprofit institution, it is committed to advancing health equity and innovation in the region, focusing on serving low-income, uninsured, and minority communities.

54aa87237468690377276809.organization_short_description:
Information Services Group, Inc. (ISG) is a global technology research and advisory firm founded in 2006 and headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut. With a workforce of approximately 1,500 professionals across over 20 countries, ISG specializes in AI advisory, digital transformation, and sourcing strategy. The company is publicly listed on NASDAQ under the ticker III.

ISG offers a wide range of services, including digital transformation, sourcing advisory, managed governance, and market intelligence. Their proprietary platforms, such as ISG Digital and ISG GovernX, support clients in managing change and optimizing operations. ISG serves over 900 clients, including 75 of the world's top 100 enterprises across various sectors, and has advised on more than $150 billion in transactions since 2010. The firm is recognized for its extensive market data and analytical capabilities, helping organizations achieve operational excellence and growth.

60663479154f070001551a4b.organization_short_description:
Eskenazi Health is a prominent public hospital system serving Marion County and Central Indiana. With a history spanning over 165 years, it is dedicated to providing high-quality, patient-focused care. The system operates as the public hospital division of the Health & Hospital Corporation of Marion County and collaborates closely with the Indiana University School of Medicine. Its main facility, the Sidney & Lois Eskenazi Hospital, features 315 beds and handles over 1 million outpatient visits each year.

The organization offers a wide range of healthcare services, including primary and specialty care, emergency medicine, trauma care, burn care, behavioral health services, surgical procedures, telehealth, and diagnostic imaging. Eskenazi Health also operates a network of community health centers throughout Indianapolis, ensuring access to care for vulnerable and underserved populations. As a nonprofit institution, it is committed to advancing health equity and innovation in the region, focusing on serving low-income, uninsured, and minority communities.

60874c806615fc0001bc5e83.organization_short_description:
Information Services Group, Inc. (ISG) is a global technology research and advisory firm founded in 2006 and headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut. With a workforce of approximately 1,500 professionals across over 20 countries, ISG specializes in AI advisory, digital transformation, and sourcing strategy. The company is publicly listed on NASDAQ under the ticker III.

ISG offers a wide range of services, including digital transformation, sourcing advisory, managed governance, and market intelligence. Their proprietary platforms, such as ISG Digital and ISG GovernX, support clients in managing change and optimizing operations. ISG serves over 900 clients, including 75 of the world's top 100 enterprises across various sectors, and has advised on more than $150 billion in transactions since 2010. The firm is recognized for its extensive market data and analytical capabilities, helping organizations achieve operational excellence and growth.

66fb3d38c0231d00010cc54d.organization_short_description:
Draper, officially known as The Charles Stark Draper Laboratory, Inc., is an independent nonprofit engineering innovation company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Founded in 1933, Draper focuses on designing, developing, and deploying advanced technology solutions to tackle global challenges in national defense, space exploration, health care, and energy. The organization became independent from MIT in 1973 and has since established itself as a leader in various engineering fields.

Draper offers a range of services across four primary areas: biotechnology systems, electronic systems, strategic systems, and space systems. Their expertise extends to human systems, cyber solutions, and autonomous systems, providing engineering services primarily to government agencies, private sector partners, and academic institutions. With approximately 2,000 employees and a revenue of $765 million in fiscal year 2023, Draper collaborates with various consortia to address complex national issues.

66150b49763895000700a7d1.organization_short_description:
Information Services Group, Inc. (ISG) is a global technology research and advisory firm founded in 2006 and headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut. With a workforce of approximately 1,500 professionals across over 20 countries, ISG specializes in AI advisory, digital transformation, and sourcing strategy. The company is publicly listed on NASDAQ under the ticker III.

ISG offers a wide range of services, including digital transformation, sourcing advisory, managed governance, and market intelligence. Their proprietary platforms, such as ISG Digital and ISG GovernX, support clients in managing change and optimizing operations. ISG serves over 900 clients, including 75 of the world's top 100 enterprises across various sectors, and has advised on more than $150 billion in transactions since 2010. The firm is recognized for its extensive market data and analytical capabilities, helping organizations achieve operational excellence and growth.

60c2248dab0aaf00017d2a99.organization_short_description:
Information Services Group, Inc. (ISG) is a global technology research and advisory firm founded in 2006 and headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut. With a workforce of approximately 1,500 professionals across over 20 countries, ISG specializes in AI advisory, digital transformation, and sourcing strategy. The company is publicly listed on NASDAQ under the ticker III.

ISG offers a wide range of services, including digital transformation, sourcing advisory, managed governance, and market intelligence. Their proprietary platforms, such as ISG Digital and ISG GovernX, support clients in managing change and optimizing operations. ISG serves over 900 clients, including 75 of the world's top 100 enterprises across various sectors, and has advised on more than $150 billion in transactions since 2010. The firm is recognized for its extensive market data and analytical capabilities, helping organizations achieve operational excellence and growth.

54ec544c7468694311fb6380.organization_short_description:
Hargrove Engineers & Constructors is a full-service EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction management) firm based in Mobile, Alabama. Founded in 1995, it is a 100% employee-owned company with over 2,700 teammates across more than 19 offices in the U.S. and internationally. Hargrove specializes in providing integrated project execution solutions, emphasizing long-term relationships with industrial clients.

The company offers a comprehensive range of services, including engineering, procurement, construction management, controls and automation, life sciences, and operations support. Hargrove also has specialized divisions, such as Hargrove Equipment Solutions, which focuses on custom equipment design and fabrication, and Tormod, which addresses environmental compliance and asset management. Hargrove serves various industries, including chemicals, refining, power generation, and aerospace, delivering flexible service models tailored to meet the needs of process-intensive clients.

6005bd527ddb51000197660f.organization_short_description:
Roswell Park Comprehensive Cancer Center, founded in 1898 by Dr. Roswell Park, is the first healthcare institution dedicated exclusively to cancer research. Located on a 28-acre campus in Buffalo, New York, it is the only National Cancer Institute-designated comprehensive cancer center outside of New York City. The center is led by President & CEO Candace Johnson, PhD, and employs over 3,200 staff, including 299 faculty members and 100 senior scientists.

The center provides advanced treatment for all forms of adult and pediatric cancer, including blood disorders, and collaborates with the John R. Oishei Children’s Hospital for pediatric care. Roswell Park conducts clinical cancer research, develops new drugs, and offers a range of support and wellness services for patients and families. It serves the Buffalo community and attracts patients from across the U.S., consistently earning high patient satisfaction scores. With a mission to understand, prevent, and cure cancer, Roswell Park continues to set national standards in cancer care, research, and education.

610e4810db23f3000107a3a5.organization_short_description:
Roswell Park Comprehensive Cancer Center, founded in 1898 by Dr. Roswell Park, is the first healthcare institution dedicated exclusively to cancer research. Located on a 28-acre campus in Buffalo, New York, it is the only National Cancer Institute-designated comprehensive cancer center outside of New York City. The center is led by President & CEO Candace Johnson, PhD, and employs over 3,200 staff, including 299 faculty members and 100 senior scientists.

The center provides advanced treatment for all forms of adult and pediatric cancer, including blood disorders, and collaborates with the John R. Oishei Children’s Hospital for pediatric care. Roswell Park conducts clinical cancer research, develops new drugs, and offers a range of support and wellness services for patients and families. It serves the Buffalo community and attracts patients from across the U.S., consistently earning high patient satisfaction scores. With a mission to understand, prevent, and cure cancer, Roswell Park continues to set national standards in cancer care, research, and education.

610280361e2be50001c9cdd7.organization_short_description:
Centria Autism is a prominent provider of Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) therapy services for children with Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) and their families. Based in Farmington Hills, Michigan, the company was established in 2009 and has since expanded its operations to 11 states across the U.S. Centria Autism employs a dedicated team of approximately 2,800 to 3,500 clinical staff, including Board-Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs) and Registered Behavior Technicians (RBTs).

The company offers a variety of ABA therapy services tailored to children aged 2 to 14 years. These services include in-home and center-based therapy, early intervention, life skills development, and autism screening. Centria Autism emphasizes a compassionate, child-led approach to therapy, focusing on evidence-based methods and practical assessments to support each child's unique needs. The company is accredited by The Joint Commission and the Behavioral Health Centers of Excellence, reflecting its commitment to high-quality care.

64138a3e3d8dd700017a0e1b.organization_short_description:
Varex Imaging Corporation is the largest independent supplier of medical and industrial X-ray imaging components. Based in Salt Lake City, Utah, the company specializes in X-ray tubes, digital detectors, image processing software, and various accessories. Founded in 2017, Varex has a strong global presence with manufacturing facilities in multiple countries, including the US, Netherlands, and China, and employs around 2,300 staff.

Varex offers a comprehensive product portfolio, producing over 25,000 X-ray tubes and 21,000 digital flat panel detectors annually. Their core products support a range of applications in medical imaging, security inspection, and industrial testing. The company serves original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) that integrate Varex components into their systems, enhancing diagnostic capabilities and safety measures across various sectors. Varex is committed to being a preferred partner for innovative X-ray imaging solutions, helping customers accelerate their market entry and improve competitiveness.

57e0782ba6da981c55f38a91.organization_short_description:
PIP Global Safety is a prominent global provider of personal protective equipment (PPE) with over 40 years of experience. Founded in 1984 in the US, the company has expanded its operations to approximately 50 countries, with its headquarters in Latham, New York. PIP Global Safety is dedicated to protecting people and the planet through innovative and reliable safety solutions, aiming to be the leader in "head-to-toe" PPE.

The company offers a diverse range of over 5,000 safety products, including hand and arm protection, head, eye, and face protection, hearing protection, and specialized protective clothing. PIP Global Safety integrates well-known brands such as Fendall™, Fibre-Metal™, and Howard Leight™ into its product lineup. Their high-performance PPE serves various sectors, including construction, mining, automotive, and fire safety, ensuring safety and comfort for professionals worldwide. With a commitment to sustainability and extensive warehousing capabilities, PIP Global Safety is a trusted partner in enhancing workplace safety and productivity.

66f70d6792ca6e00018b0ac4.organization_short_description:
PIP Global Safety is a prominent global provider of personal protective equipment (PPE) with over 40 years of experience. Founded in 1984 in the US, the company has expanded its operations to approximately 50 countries, with its headquarters in Latham, New York. PIP Global Safety is dedicated to protecting people and the planet through innovative and reliable safety solutions, aiming to be the leader in "head-to-toe" PPE.

The company offers a diverse range of over 5,000 safety products, including hand and arm protection, head, eye, and face protection, hearing protection, and specialized protective clothing. PIP Global Safety integrates well-known brands such as Fendall™, Fibre-Metal™, and Howard Leight™ into its product lineup. Their high-performance PPE serves various sectors, including construction, mining, automotive, and fire safety, ensuring safety and comfort for professionals worldwide. With a commitment to sustainability and extensive warehousing capabilities, PIP Global Safety is a trusted partner in enhancing workplace safety and productivity.

69c4c5c77d7e890001fe510d.organization_short_description:
Varex Imaging Corporation is the largest independent supplier of medical and industrial X-ray imaging components. Based in Salt Lake City, Utah, the company specializes in X-ray tubes, digital detectors, image processing software, and various accessories. Founded in 2017, Varex has a strong global presence with manufacturing facilities in multiple countries, including the US, Netherlands, and China, and employs around 2,300 staff.

Varex offers a comprehensive product portfolio, producing over 25,000 X-ray tubes and 21,000 digital flat panel detectors annually. Their core products support a range of applications in medical imaging, security inspection, and industrial testing. The company serves original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) that integrate Varex components into their systems, enhancing diagnostic capabilities and safety measures across various sectors. Varex is committed to being a preferred partner for innovative X-ray imaging solutions, helping customers accelerate their market entry and improve competitiveness.

60fb2d2e48b601000167b3a9.organization_short_description:
Navitus Health Solutions is a pharmacy benefit manager (PBM) founded in 2003, dedicated to providing affordable medication access to nearly 18 million members across 800 clients. The company is owned by SSM Health and Costco Wholesale Corporation and operates as a pass-through alternative to traditional PBMs, ensuring that 100% of negotiated rebates and discounts are returned directly to health plans and sponsors.

Navitus offers its services through three brands: Navitus, which serves as the core PBM; Lumicera, a URAC-accredited specialty pharmacy; and Archimedes, which focuses on clinical and analytical capabilities for specialty drug management. The company emphasizes financial and operational transparency, cost reduction strategies, and customizable pharmacy benefit plans. Headquartered in Madison, Wisconsin, with additional campuses in Appleton, Austin, and Phoenix, Navitus has been recognized as a "Great Place to Work" for 2025–2026 and holds a 4.5-Star EGWP Rating by CMS, the highest among PBMs.

5f87487ebad2930001e4af13.organization_short_description:
Rady Children’s Hospital–San Diego is the only hospital in the region dedicated exclusively to pediatric health care and serves as the sole designated Level I pediatric trauma center. This nonprofit, 511-bed facility provides comprehensive care for children from birth to 18 years old, and up to 21 years for certain subspecialties. It is recognized as California’s largest children’s hospital by volume, with over 20,000 inpatient admissions and 250,000 outpatient visits in 2019.

The hospital is affiliated with the UC San Diego School of Medicine and is a major pediatric clinical research center. Rady Children’s offers a wide range of pediatric specialties, including trauma services, psychiatric care, and genomic medicine. It is home to a Genomic Institute that focuses on rapid whole genome sequencing. With a dedicated staff of over 1,000 physicians and 1,500 nurses, Rady Children’s is committed to enhancing the health and developmental potential of children through excellence in care, education, research, and advocacy.

66f3b082f18fea0001e99e81.organization_short_description:
Spin Master Corp. is a global leader in children's entertainment, headquartered in Toronto, Canada. The company is publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol TSX: TOY. Spin Master focuses on creating magical play experiences through its three creative centers: Toys, Entertainment, and Digital Games. With approximately 3,000 employees and a presence in nearly 20 countries, Spin Master distributes its products in over 100 countries worldwide.

The company designs and manufactures a diverse range of innovative toys and games, including popular brands like PAW Patrol®, Bakugan®, and Kinetic Sand®. Spin Master also produces engaging multiplatform content through its entertainment division, which includes preschool franchises and feature films. In the digital space, the company offers creative and educational games under brands such as Toca Boca® and Sago Mini®. Additionally, Spin Master Ventures invests in emerging companies to foster innovation in the children's entertainment sector.

66f6b6434e64ab000171faaa.organization_short_description:
Spin Master Corp. is a global leader in children's entertainment, headquartered in Toronto, Canada. The company is publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol TSX: TOY. Spin Master focuses on creating magical play experiences through its three creative centers: Toys, Entertainment, and Digital Games. With approximately 3,000 employees and a presence in nearly 20 countries, Spin Master distributes its products in over 100 countries worldwide.

The company designs and manufactures a diverse range of innovative toys and games, including popular brands like PAW Patrol®, Bakugan®, and Kinetic Sand®. Spin Master also produces engaging multiplatform content through its entertainment division, which includes preschool franchises and feature films. In the digital space, the company offers creative and educational games under brands such as Toca Boca® and Sago Mini®. Additionally, Spin Master Ventures invests in emerging companies to foster innovation in the children's entertainment sector.

611babfa9ec04c00010316c3.organization_short_description:
Spin Master Corp. is a global leader in children's entertainment, headquartered in Toronto, Canada. The company is publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol TSX: TOY. Spin Master focuses on creating magical play experiences through its three creative centers: Toys, Entertainment, and Digital Games. With approximately 3,000 employees and a presence in nearly 20 countries, Spin Master distributes its products in over 100 countries worldwide.

The company designs and manufactures a diverse range of innovative toys and games, including popular brands like PAW Patrol®, Bakugan®, and Kinetic Sand®. Spin Master also produces engaging multiplatform content through its entertainment division, which includes preschool franchises and feature films. In the digital space, the company offers creative and educational games under brands such as Toca Boca® and Sago Mini®. Additionally, Spin Master Ventures invests in emerging companies to foster innovation in the children's entertainment sector.

66f70dab92ca6e00018b19de.organization_short_description:
PIP Global Safety is a prominent global provider of personal protective equipment (PPE) with over 40 years of experience. Founded in 1984 in the US, the company has expanded its operations to approximately 50 countries, with its headquarters in Latham, New York. PIP Global Safety is dedicated to protecting people and the planet through innovative and reliable safety solutions, aiming to be the leader in "head-to-toe" PPE.

The company offers a diverse range of over 5,000 safety products, including hand and arm protection, head, eye, and face protection, hearing protection, and specialized protective clothing. PIP Global Safety integrates well-known brands such as Fendall™, Fibre-Metal™, and Howard Leight™ into its product lineup. Their high-performance PPE serves various sectors, including construction, mining, automotive, and fire safety, ensuring safety and comfort for professionals worldwide. With a commitment to sustainability and extensive warehousing capabilities, PIP Global Safety is a trusted partner in enhancing workplace safety and productivity.

54a5e83b7468693209eb95b2.organization_short_description:
OEC, also known as OEConnection, is a leading global provider of automotive technology and an end-to-end SaaS platform. Founded in 2000 in Richfield, Ohio, the company serves as a vital digital backbone for the automotive aftersales ecosystem. OEC enables automakers and their dealer networks to enhance the sale of original equipment (OE) parts across various segments, including collision, fleet, mechanical, and retail.

The company offers a comprehensive suite of services, including SaaS e-commerce, pricing, supply chain management, business intelligence, parts cataloging, and data products. Key products such as CollisionLink, RepairLink, and PartsTech streamline workflows for collision repair, parts ordering, and technician-dealer connectivity. OEC supports over 30,000 auto dealers, 36 global OEM brands, and more than 135,000 auto repairers, making it an essential partner in the automotive repair and parts supply chain. With headquarters in Ohio and international offices, OEC operates across the U.S., Canada, and globally.

610b93f8da444000011c9518.organization_short_description:
OEC, also known as OEConnection, is a leading global provider of automotive technology and an end-to-end SaaS platform. Founded in 2000 in Richfield, Ohio, the company serves as a vital digital backbone for the automotive aftersales ecosystem. OEC enables automakers and their dealer networks to enhance the sale of original equipment (OE) parts across various segments, including collision, fleet, mechanical, and retail.

The company offers a comprehensive suite of services, including SaaS e-commerce, pricing, supply chain management, business intelligence, parts cataloging, and data products. Key products such as CollisionLink, RepairLink, and PartsTech streamline workflows for collision repair, parts ordering, and technician-dealer connectivity. OEC supports over 30,000 auto dealers, 36 global OEM brands, and more than 135,000 auto repairers, making it an essential partner in the automotive repair and parts supply chain. With headquarters in Ohio and international offices, OEC operates across the U.S., Canada, and globally.

61f55ad0af71740001d9dd6d.organization_short_description:
OEC, also known as OEConnection, is a leading global provider of automotive technology and an end-to-end SaaS platform. Founded in 2000 in Richfield, Ohio, the company serves as a vital digital backbone for the automotive aftersales ecosystem. OEC enables automakers and their dealer networks to enhance the sale of original equipment (OE) parts across various segments, including collision, fleet, mechanical, and retail.

The company offers a comprehensive suite of services, including SaaS e-commerce, pricing, supply chain management, business intelligence, parts cataloging, and data products. Key products such as CollisionLink, RepairLink, and PartsTech streamline workflows for collision repair, parts ordering, and technician-dealer connectivity. OEC supports over 30,000 auto dealers, 36 global OEM brands, and more than 135,000 auto repairers, making it an essential partner in the automotive repair and parts supply chain. With headquarters in Ohio and international offices, OEC operates across the U.S., Canada, and globally.

659783ca4603d30001047dd5.organization_short_description:
Roswell Park Comprehensive Cancer Center, founded in 1898 by Dr. Roswell Park, is the first healthcare institution dedicated exclusively to cancer research. Located on a 28-acre campus in Buffalo, New York, it is the only National Cancer Institute-designated comprehensive cancer center outside of New York City. The center is led by President & CEO Candace Johnson, PhD, and employs over 3,200 staff, including 299 faculty members and 100 senior scientists.

The center provides advanced treatment for all forms of adult and pediatric cancer, including blood disorders, and collaborates with the John R. Oishei Children’s Hospital for pediatric care. Roswell Park conducts clinical cancer research, develops new drugs, and offers a range of support and wellness services for patients and families. It serves the Buffalo community and attracts patients from across the U.S., consistently earning high patient satisfaction scores. With a mission to understand, prevent, and cure cancer, Roswell Park continues to set national standards in cancer care, research, and education.

5fc472d1e8a20a0001c8388f.organization_short_description:
Spin Master Corp. is a global leader in children's entertainment, headquartered in Toronto, Canada. The company is publicly traded on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol TSX: TOY. Spin Master focuses on creating magical play experiences through its three creative centers: Toys, Entertainment, and Digital Games. With approximately 3,000 employees and a presence in nearly 20 countries, Spin Master distributes its products in over 100 countries worldwide.

The company designs and manufactures a diverse range of innovative toys and games, including popular brands like PAW Patrol®, Bakugan®, and Kinetic Sand®. Spin Master also produces engaging multiplatform content through its entertainment division, which includes preschool franchises and feature films. In the digital space, the company offers creative and educational games under brands such as Toca Boca® and Sago Mini®. Additionally, Spin Master Ventures invests in emerging companies to foster innovation in the children's entertainment sector.

66c039eb5183350001e3bacd.organization_short_description:
Vigor Marine Group is a prominent American company specializing in shipbuilding, ship repair, and marine services, based in Portland, Oregon. Formerly known as Vigor Industrial, the company rebranded in June 2025 after consolidating five marine and industrial service firms. It operates as a full-service prime contractor across the United States, catering to both government and commercial clients in the defense, maritime, and cruise sectors.

The company employs around 2,500 to 2,700 professionals and operates five shipyards and multiple drydocks, including North America’s largest floating dry dock, *Vigorous*. Vigor Marine Group is organized into three main divisions: Maintenance & Modernization, Marine Services, and Marine Fabrication. These divisions provide a range of services, including vessel repairs, environmental compliance, new vessel construction, and lifecycle management for military and commercial fleets. With a revenue of nearly $1 billion in 2024, Vigor Marine Group is recognized for its commitment to excellence and innovation in the maritime industry.

These divisions provide a range of services, including vessel repairs, environmental compliance, new vessel construction, and lifecycle management for military and commercial fleets. With a revenue of nearly $1 billion in 2024, Vigor Marine Group is recognized for its commitment to excellence and innovation in the maritime industry.

60d0871df226620001dc03a7.organization_short_description:
The Ohio State University, commonly known as Ohio State or OSU, is a public research university located in Columbus, Ohio. Founded in 1870, it serves as the flagship institution of the University System of Ohio and is classified as an R1: Doctoral University for its high research activity. The university offers a wide range of services and degree programs, including 170 undergraduate majors and over 250 graduate programs across 15 colleges.

Ohio State is home to Ohio's top academic medical center and a premier cancer hospital. It focuses on research in various fields, including climate change, cancer, and infectious diseases, supported by an annual research budget of nearly $1 billion. The university serves over 50,000 undergraduate and 15,000 graduate students, with regional campuses across Ohio. Additionally, it is known for its Division I football team, the Buckeyes, which attracts a large following among sports fans and alumni.

57c6bc8fa6da9817fd3cf9d9.organization_short_description:
The Ohio State University, commonly known as Ohio State or OSU, is a public research university located in Columbus, Ohio. Founded in 1870, it serves as the flagship institution of the University System of Ohio and is classified as an R1: Doctoral University for its high research activity. The university offers a wide range of services and degree programs, including 170 undergraduate majors and over 250 graduate programs across 15 colleges.

Ohio State is home to Ohio's top academic medical center and a premier cancer hospital. It focuses on research in various fields, including climate change, cancer, and infectious diseases, supported by an annual research budget of nearly $1 billion. 66fb488aa8908c000181ef0b.organization_short_description:
The Ohio State University, commonly known as Ohio State or OSU, is a public research university located in Columbus, Ohio. Founded in 1870, it serves as the flagship institution of the University System of Ohio and is classified as an R1: Doctoral University for its high research activity. The university offers a wide range of services and degree programs, including 170 undergraduate majors and over 250 graduate programs across 15 colleges.

Ohio State is home to Ohio's top academic medical center and a premier cancer hospital. It focuses on research in various fields, including climate change, cancer, and infectious diseases, supported by an annual research budget of nearly $1 billion. The university serves over 50,000 undergraduate and 15,000 graduate students, with regional campuses across Ohio. Additionally, it is known for its Division I football team, the Buckeyes, which attracts a large following among sports fans and alumni.

611c3fff5685570001a61a2a.organization_short_description:
Thumbtack is an online home services marketplace that connects homeowners with local service professionals across the United States. Founded in 2008 and based in San Francisco, the platform allows users to compare prices, read reviews, and hire vetted professionals through its website and mobile app. Thumbtack operates in all 50 states, serving millions of users with a network of around 300,000 local service businesses across more than 1,100 service categories.

The platform offers a hiring service where users can request custom quotes from qualified professionals and access home management tools that provide personalized project guidance. Thumbtack has integrated AI features to enhance decision-making and has expanded its services beyond home improvement to include wellness, education, and event planning. The company is privately held and has raised significant funding to support its growth, facilitating over 12 million 5-star projects and generating substantial revenue for local service professionals.

54a71cbb74686975f8208016.organization_short_description:
Bassett Furniture Industries, Inc. is a prominent American manufacturer and retailer of home furnishings, established in 1902 by John David Bassett, Sr. Headquartered in Bassett, Virginia, the company operates manufacturing facilities in Alabama and Virginia, employing around 1,200 to 1,400 people. Bassett specializes in high-quality, mid-priced furniture, offering custom-built solutions with a focus on customer satisfaction.

The company operates through three main segments: wholesale distribution to independent retailers, retail sales through company-owned stores, and corporate functions. Bassett provides a wide range of services, including custom furniture manufacturing, in-home design consultations, and virtual appointments. Their product portfolio encompasses bedroom, living room, dining room, and outdoor furniture, along with home decor and accessories. With a robust distribution network, Bassett serves individual consumers and business partners across the United States and internationally.

54c1d83174686916393bf34f.organization_short_description:
OEC, also known as OEConnection, is a leading global provider of automotive technology and an end-to-end SaaS platform. Founded in 2000 in Richfield, Ohio, the company serves as a vital digital backbone for the automotive aftersales ecosystem. OEC enables automakers and their dealer networks to enhance the sale of original equipment (OE) parts across various segments, including collision, fleet, mechanical, and retail.

The company offers a comprehensive suite of services, including SaaS e-commerce, pricing, supply chain management, business intelligence, parts cataloging, and data products. Key products such as CollisionLink, RepairLink, and PartsTech streamline workflows for collision repair, parts ordering, and technician-dealer connectivity. OEC supports over 30,000 auto dealers, 36 global OEM brands, and more than 135,000 auto repairers, making it an essential partner in the automotive repair and parts supply chain. With headquarters in Ohio and international offices, OEC operates across the U.S., Canada, and globally.

611209ad6594eb00013581ac.organization_short_description:
Thumbtack is an online home services marketplace that connects homeowners with local service professionals across the United States. Founded in 2008 and based in San Francisco, the platform allows users to compare prices, read reviews, and hire vetted professionals through its website and mobile app. Thumbtack operates in all 50 states, serving millions of users with a network of around 300,000 local service businesses across more than 1,100 service categories.

The platform offers a hiring service where users can request custom quotes from qualified professionals and access home management tools that provide personalized project guidance. Thumbtack has integrated AI features to enhance decision-making and has expanded its services beyond home improvement to include wellness, education, and event planning. The company is privately held and has raised significant funding to support its growth, facilitating over 12 million 5-star projects and generating substantial revenue for local service professionals.

66fb4e5ca8908c000183d725.organization_short_description:
The Ohio State University, commonly known as Ohio State or OSU, is a public research university located in Columbus, Ohio. Founded in 1870, it serves as the flagship institution of the University System of Ohio and is classified as an R1: Doctoral University for its high research activity. The university offers a wide range of services and degree programs, including 170 undergraduate majors and over 250 graduate programs across 15 colleges.

Ohio State is home to Ohio's top academic medical center and a premier cancer hospital. It focuses on research in various fields, including climate change, cancer, and infectious diseases, supported by an annual research budget of nearly $1 billion. The university serves over 50,000 undergraduate and 15,000 graduate students, with regional campuses across Ohio. Additionally, it is known for its Division I football team, the Buckeyes, which attracts a large following among sports fans and alumni.

60af6ba522f14d0001adf0f6.organization_short_description:
ACV Auctions is a technology company based in Buffalo, New York, that operates a leading online wholesale automotive marketplace. Founded in August 2014, the company connects over 22,000 active dealers, facilitating efficient and transparent vehicle transactions through its proprietary 20-minute live digital auction platform. This platform allows dealers to buy and sell trade-ins, aged units, and wholesale inventory quickly and effectively.

In addition to its auction services, ACV offers value-added products such as ACV Transportation for vehicle logistics, ACV Capital for inventory financing, and Go Green Assurance for seller protection against vehicle defects. The company also provides data services that deliver insights into the condition and value of used vehicles, enhancing the transaction experience for both dealers and commercial partners. ACV Auctions went public in 2021 and continues to grow, with a mission to create trusted and efficient digital marketplaces for used vehicles.
