60c1f01fa6adaa0001eb6b4d.organization_short_description:
Thumbtack is an online home services marketplace that connects homeowners with local service professionals across the United States. Founded in 2008 and based in San Francisco, the platform allows users to compare prices, read reviews, and hire vetted professionals through its website and mobile app. Thumbtack operates in all 50 states, serving millions of users with a network of around 300,000 local service businesses across more than 1,100 service categories.

The platform offers a hiring service where users can request custom quotes from qualified professionals and access home management tools that provide personalized project guidance. Thumbtack has integrated AI features to enhance decision-making and has expanded its services beyond home improvement to include wellness, education, and event planning. The company is privately held and has raised significant funding to support its growth, facilitating over 12 million 5-star projects and generating substantial revenue for local service professionals.

54ebc449746869444c1d5420.organization_short_description:
Bassett Furniture Industries, Inc. is a prominent American manufacturer and retailer of home furnishings, established in 1902 by John David Bassett, Sr. Headquartered in Bassett, Virginia, the company operates manufacturing facilities in Alabama and Virginia, employing around 1,200 to 1,400 people. Bassett specializes in high-quality, mid-priced furniture, offering custom-built solutions with a focus on customer satisfaction.

The company operates through three main segments: wholesale distribution to independent retailers, retail sales through company-owned stores, and corporate functions. Bassett provides a wide range of services, including custom furniture manufacturing, in-home design consultations, and virtual appointments. Their product portfolio encompasses bedroom, living room, dining room, and outdoor furniture, along with home decor and accessories. With a robust distribution network, Bassett serves individual consumers and business partners across the United States and internationally.

60e5946468c0ed00013f4e91.organization_short_description:
Atmus Filtration Technologies Inc. is a global leader in filtration and media solutions, dedicated to protecting assets and enhancing the performance of commercial vehicles and off-highway equipment. Founded in 1958 in Nashville, Tennessee, Atmus has a rich history of innovation and was previously part of Cummins Inc. It became a standalone publicly traded company in 2022, with its IPO completed in 2023.

The company offers a diverse portfolio of approximately 25,000 products, including filters for fuel, oil, air, and hydraulic systems, as well as maintenance chemicals and specialized components. Atmus focuses on developing advanced filtration technologies and provides service-related solutions, including remote digital diagnostics. With a strong presence across six continents and around 4,500 employees, Atmus serves various industries, including trucking, agriculture, construction, mining, power generation, and marine, ensuring high-performance filtration for enhanced equipment durability and efficiency.

57d7de71a6da980a16bdb4a2.organization_short_description:
Carrier Global Corporation is a leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, offering a range of digitally enabled products and services for homes, buildings, and the cold chain. Founded in 1915 and headquartered in Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, the company operates in 160 countries with around 53,000 employees and manages over 35 trusted brands, including Carrier, Bryant, and Toshiba Carrier.

Carrier's offerings include HVAC systems such as heat pumps, furnaces, and air conditioners, as well as refrigeration solutions for commercial and industrial applications. The company also provides fire safety systems, security solutions, and smart building automation controls. With a focus on digital and energy-efficient solutions, Carrier aims to enhance comfort, safety, and sustainability for various customer segments, including residential, commercial, healthcare, and transportation industries. The company is publicly traded under the stock symbol CARR and reported revenue of approximately $21.9–$24.8 billion.

5e6fe732058a2a0001d34dd4.organization_short_description:
Volkswagen AG is a prominent German automotive manufacturer based in Wolfsburg, Germany. Founded in 1937, the company aims to produce affordable vehicles for the general public. As the flagship brand of the Volkswagen Group, it encompasses several well-known brands, including Audi, Porsche, and Lamborghini. Volkswagen operates in over 150 countries, with a robust network of manufacturing plants and dealerships.

The company specializes in the mass production of a wide range of vehicles, including sedans, SUVs, and electric vehicles (EVs). Volkswagen is committed to electric mobility, offering models like the ID.3, ID.4, and ID.Buzz, along with advanced digital services such as remote vehicle control and navigation updates. Additionally, Volkswagen provides corporate and financial services, ensuring compliance with data protection laws and offering dedicated customer support. With a focus on innovation and sustainability, Volkswagen continues to deliver reliable transportation solutions for diverse customer needs.

66fdc9a2d36f19000120a6d4.organization_short_description:
True Manufacturing Co., Inc. is a leading American manufacturer and global supplier of refrigeration equipment, established in 1945 by the Trulaske family in St. Louis, Missouri. The company is headquartered in O'Fallon, Missouri, and operates over 4.2 million square feet of manufacturing space, employing around 1,000 to 1,200 people. True Manufacturing is recognized for its commitment to durability, energy efficiency, and high-quality craftsmanship, with an estimated annual revenue of approximately $275.3 million.

The company offers a wide range of refrigeration products for commercial, residential, and scientific applications. Their product lines include heavy-duty refrigerators and freezers, food prep tables, undercounter units, and specialized scientific refrigeration systems. True Manufacturing also provides custom refrigeration solutions, energy efficiency consulting, and ongoing maintenance and support. With a focus on sustainability, the company emphasizes eco-friendly design and the use of low-GWP refrigerants, ensuring compliance with ENERGY STAR® standards.

673ece2da2ae0200017af282.organization_short_description:
Volkswagen AG is a prominent German automotive manufacturer based in Wolfsburg, Germany. Founded in 1937, the company aims to produce affordable vehicles for the general public. As the flagship brand of the Volkswagen Group, it encompasses several well-known brands, including Audi, Porsche, and Lamborghini. Volkswagen operates in over 150 countries, with a robust network of manufacturing plants and dealerships.

The company specializes in the mass production of a wide range of vehicles, including sedans, SUVs, and electric vehicles (EVs). Volkswagen is committed to electric mobility, offering models like the ID.3, ID.4, and ID.Buzz, along with advanced digital services such as remote vehicle control and navigation updates. Additionally, Volkswagen provides corporate and financial services, ensuring compliance with data protection laws and offering dedicated customer support. With a focus on innovation and sustainability, Volkswagen continues to deliver reliable transportation solutions for diverse customer needs.

57df32c8a6da980acde122dc.organization_short_description:
SPX FLOW solves processing challenges, helping customers lower costs, increase uptime, save energy, reduce waste, and improve quality.

We manufacture and deliver high-value technology, service and support to leading nutrition, health, and industrial businesses around the world. From dairy processors and mixers to our state-of-the-art Innovation Centers, we collaborate with customers to develop and perfect their critical manufacturing processes. Our inventive pumps, values and systems make it easy to provide end-users with high quality products while cutting production costs. We support you, as you support them.  

With operations in more than 25 countries, we meet the varying needs of our diverse customer base to make life safer, healthier and more sustainable. To learn more, please visit spxflow.com

660fb81c3e45750007085d29.organization_short_description:
True Manufacturing Co., Inc. is a leading American manufacturer and global supplier of refrigeration equipment, established in 1945 by the Trulaske family in St. Louis, Missouri. The company is headquartered in O'Fallon, Missouri, and operates over 4.2 million square feet of manufacturing space, employing around 1,000 to 1,200 people. True Manufacturing is recognized for its commitment to durability, energy efficiency, and high-quality craftsmanship, with an estimated annual revenue of approximately $275.3 million.

The company offers a wide range of refrigeration products for commercial, residential, and scientific applications. Their product lines include heavy-duty refrigerators and freezers, food prep tables, undercounter units, and specialized scientific refrigeration systems. True Manufacturing also provides custom refrigeration solutions, energy efficiency consulting, and ongoing maintenance and support. With a focus on sustainability, the company emphasizes eco-friendly design and the use of low-GWP refrigerants, ensuring compliance with ENERGY STAR® standards.

SPX FLOW solves processing challenges, helping customers lower costs, increase uptime, save energy, reduce waste, and improve quality.

We manufacture and deliver high-value technology, service and support to leading nutrition, health, and industrial businesses around the world. From dairy processors and mixers to our state-of-the-art Innovation Centers, we collaborate with customers to develop and perfect their critical manufacturing processes. Our inventive pumps, values and systems make it easy to provide end-users with high quality products while cutting production costs. We support you, as you support them.  

With operations in more than 25 countries, we meet the varying needs of our diverse customer base to make life safer, healthier and more sustainable. To learn more, please visit spxflow.com

590889129d79680397b17067.organization_short_description:
TRIMEDX is an independent clinical asset management firm based in Indianapolis, Indiana. Founded in 1998, it has grown to become the largest independent company of its kind in the United States, serving over 1,800 healthcare facilities globally. With a workforce of approximately 3,400 to 5,000 professionals, TRIMEDX generates an estimated annual revenue between $500 million and $1 billion. The company focuses on optimizing clinical assets to reduce operational costs, enhance patient care, and improve safety and cybersecurity.

TRIMEDX offers a wide range of services, including medical device maintenance and repair, lifecycle management, asset tracking, and cybersecurity solutions. Its proprietary technology, such as the GeoSense real-time location system, enhances asset visibility and operational efficiency. The company serves various healthcare segments, including large healthcare systems, community hospitals, and specialty care centers, providing tailored solutions to meet their specific needs. TRIMEDX is committed to driving operational savings and improving risk management for its clients.

5e77d730f447510001bccfa3.organization_short_description:
Carenet Health, based in San Antonio, Texas, provides tech-enabled healthcare services and AI-powered healthcare engagement solutions. Founded in 1988, the company partners with over 500 healthcare leaders, including top health systems and payers, to enhance patient outcomes and reduce costs. With more than 25 years of experience, Carenet operates a 24/7 healthcare support center and is recognized for its expertise in telehealth, patient advocacy, and care coordination.

Carenet Health offers a wide range of services, including nurse advice lines, virtual doctor consultations, chronic care management, and medication adherence support. They also provide operational support for emergency room diversion and readmissions reduction, along with technology solutions like AI automation and population health analytics. The company serves a diverse clientele, including healthcare organizations, Fortune 500 companies, and government programs, reaching over 65 million healthcare consumers annually. Their mission focuses on driving consumer engagement through innovative methodologies.

66fae23d016df50001f225ec.organization_short_description:
SPX FLOW solves processing challenges, helping customers lower costs, increase uptime, save energy, reduce waste, and improve quality.

We manufacture and deliver high-value technology, service and support to leading nutrition, health, and industrial businesses around the world. From dairy processors and mixers to our state-of-the-art Innovation Centers, we collaborate with customers to develop and perfect their critical manufacturing processes. Our inventive pumps, values and systems make it easy to provide end-users with high quality products while cutting production costs. We support you, as you support them.  

With operations in more than 25 countries, we meet the varying needs of our diverse customer base to make life safer, healthier and more sustainable. To learn more, please visit spxflow.com

66f109df84c8cd00013d79b2.organization_short_description:
Carenet Health, based in San Antonio, Texas, provides tech-enabled healthcare services and AI-powered healthcare engagement solutions. Founded in 1988, the company partners with over 500 healthcare leaders, including top health systems and payers, to enhance patient outcomes and reduce costs. With more than 25 years of experience, Carenet operates a 24/7 healthcare support center and is recognized for its expertise in telehealth, patient advocacy, and care coordination.

Carenet Health offers a wide range of services, including nurse advice lines, virtual doctor consultations, chronic care management, and medication adherence support. They also provide operational support for emergency room diversion and readmissions reduction, along with technology solutions like AI automation and population health analytics. The company serves a diverse clientele, including healthcare organizations, Fortune 500 companies, and government programs, reaching over 65 million healthcare consumers annually. Their mission focuses on driving consumer engagement through innovative methodologies.

54aaba0774686923665e0016.organization_short_description:
TRIMEDX is an independent clinical asset management firm based in Indianapolis, Indiana. Founded in 1998, it has grown to become the largest independent company of its kind in the United States, serving over 1,800 healthcare facilities globally. With a workforce of approximately 3,400 to 5,000 professionals, TRIMEDX generates an estimated annual revenue between $500 million and $1 billion. The company focuses on optimizing clinical assets to reduce operational costs, enhance patient care, and improve safety and cybersecurity.

TRIMEDX offers a wide range of services, including medical device maintenance and repair, lifecycle management, asset tracking, and cybersecurity solutions. Its proprietary technology, such as the GeoSense real-time location system, enhances asset visibility and operational efficiency. The company serves various healthcare segments, including large healthcare systems, community hospitals, and specialty care centers, providing tailored solutions to meet their specific needs. TRIMEDX is committed to driving operational savings and improving risk management for its clients.

66fc902ff037a60001d3192b.organization_short_description:
SPX FLOW solves processing challenges, helping customers lower costs, increase uptime, save energy, reduce waste, and improve quality.

We manufacture and deliver high-value technology, service and support to leading nutrition, health, and industrial businesses around the world. From dairy processors and mixers to our state-of-the-art Innovation Centers, we collaborate with customers to develop and perfect their critical manufacturing processes. Our inventive pumps, values and systems make it easy to provide end-users with high quality products while cutting production costs. We support you, as you support them.  

With operations in more than 25 countries, we meet the varying needs of our diverse customer base to make life safer, healthier and more sustainable. To learn more, please visit spxflow.com

66f810d7a8551a0001341827.organization_short_description:
Atmus Filtration Technologies Inc. is a global leader in filtration and media solutions, dedicated to protecting assets and enhancing the performance of commercial vehicles and off-highway equipment. Founded in 1958 in Nashville, Tennessee, Atmus has a rich history of innovation and was previously part of Cummins Inc. It became a standalone publicly traded company in 2022, with its IPO completed in 2023.

The company offers a diverse portfolio of approximately 25,000 products, including filters for fuel, oil, air, and hydraulic systems, as well as maintenance chemicals and specialized components. Atmus focuses on developing advanced filtration technologies and provides service-related solutions, including remote digital diagnostics. With a strong presence across six continents and around 4,500 employees, Atmus serves various industries, including trucking, agriculture, construction, mining, power generation, and marine, ensuring high-performance filtration for enhanced equipment durability and efficiency.

54a81e697468696829905461.organization_short_description:
TRIMEDX is an independent clinical asset management firm based in Indianapolis, Indiana. Founded in 1998, it has grown to become the largest independent company of its kind in the United States, serving over 1,800 healthcare facilities globally. With a workforce of approximately 3,400 to 5,000 professionals, TRIMEDX generates an estimated annual revenue between $500 million and $1 billion. The company focuses on optimizing clinical assets to reduce operational costs, enhance patient care, and improve safety and cybersecurity.

TRIMEDX offers a wide range of services, including medical device maintenance and repair, lifecycle management, asset tracking, and cybersecurity solutions. Its proprietary technology, such as the GeoSense real-time location system, enhances asset visibility and operational efficiency. The company serves various healthcare segments, including large healthcare systems, community hospitals, and specialty care centers, providing tailored solutions to meet their specific needs. TRIMEDX is committed to driving operational savings and improving risk management for its clients.

64eec5896ad3770001fc0912.organization_short_description:
PT Solutions Physical Therapy is a prominent physical therapy practice founded in 2003 and headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. 6605907ce6e3d00007acb221.organization_short_description:
PT Solutions Physical Therapy is a prominent physical therapy practice founded in 2003 and headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. With over 550 locations across 25 states, the company focuses on delivering research-supported care that promotes functional independence and aids in quick recovery for patients.

The practice offers a comprehensive range of rehabilitation and therapy services, including physical therapy, occupational therapy, speech-language pathology, athletic training, and sports medicine. They also specialize in orthopaedic and neurologic residency programs, women's health physical therapy, and clinician mentorship. PT Solutions serves a diverse clientele, including children, athletes, and individuals recovering from work-related injuries, providing care in outpatient, inpatient, and acute care settings through partnerships with hospitals and private acquisitions. Appointments are typically available within 24–48 hours at many locations.

6105396f396c0d00018fd127.organization_short_description:
TRIMEDX is an independent clinical asset management firm based in Indianapolis, Indiana. Founded in 1998, it has grown to become the largest independent company of its kind in the United States, serving over 1,800 healthcare facilities globally. With a workforce of approximately 3,400 to 5,000 professionals, TRIMEDX generates an estimated annual revenue between $500 million and $1 billion. The company focuses on optimizing clinical assets to reduce operational costs, enhance patient care, and improve safety and cybersecurity.

TRIMEDX offers a wide range of services, including medical device maintenance and repair, lifecycle management, asset tracking, and cybersecurity solutions. Its proprietary technology, such as the GeoSense real-time location system, enhances asset visibility and operational efficiency. The company serves various healthcare segments, including large healthcare systems, community hospitals, and specialty care centers, providing tailored solutions to meet their specific needs. TRIMEDX is committed to driving operational savings and improving risk management for its clients.

60db4b60bb5ccd0001969375.organization_short_description:
Fluke Corporation is a prominent American manufacturer of electronic test, measurement, and diagnostic equipment, based in Everett, Washington. Established in 1948 by John Fluke, Sr., the company is recognized as a leader in electronic test tools and software, operating as a subsidiary of Fortive Corporation. Fluke employs around 4,162 people and has manufacturing centers in the USA, UK, Asia, and the Netherlands, with a presence in over 100 countries.

Fluke offers a wide range of products, including digital voltmeters, thermal imaging cameras, and network troubleshooting tools. Their tools are designed for various applications in industries such as manufacturing, medical, and IT. The company also provides calibration and maintenance services through its Fluke Calibration division, along with predictive maintenance solutions. Fluke's mission is to deliver reliable testing and troubleshooting capabilities, ensuring the quality and safety of critical equipment across multiple sectors.

60d98f6e87db6a0001355b66.organization_short_description:
Fluke Corporation is a prominent American manufacturer of electronic test, measurement, and diagnostic equipment, based in Everett, Washington. Established in 1948 by John Fluke, Sr., the company is recognized as a leader in electronic test tools and software, operating as a subsidiary of Fortive Corporation. Fluke employs around 4,162 people and has manufacturing centers in the USA, UK, Asia, and the Netherlands, with a presence in over 100 countries.

Fluke offers a wide range of products, including digital voltmeters, thermal imaging cameras, and network troubleshooting tools. Their tools are designed for various applications in industries such as manufacturing, medical, and IT. The company also provides calibration and maintenance services through its Fluke Calibration division, along with predictive maintenance solutions. Fluke's mission is to deliver reliable testing and troubleshooting capabilities, ensuring the quality and safety of critical equipment across multiple sectors.

5ade1efea6da984de58bedb7.organization_short_description:
Fluke Corporation is a prominent American manufacturer of electronic test, measurement, and diagnostic equipment, based in Everett, Washington. Established in 1948 by John Fluke, Sr., the company is recognized as a leader in electronic test tools and software, operating as a subsidiary of Fortive Corporation. Fluke employs around 4,162 people and has manufacturing centers in the USA, UK, Asia, and the Netherlands, with a presence in over 100 countries.

Fluke offers a wide range of products, including digital voltmeters, thermal imaging cameras, and network troubleshooting tools. Their tools are designed for various applications in industries such as manufacturing, medical, and IT. The company also provides calibration and maintenance services through its Fluke Calibration division, along with predictive maintenance solutions. Fluke's mission is to deliver reliable testing and troubleshooting capabilities, ensuring the quality and safety of critical equipment across multiple sectors.

666945e2cf87250001f96351.organization_short_description:
CORT is a leading provider of transition services, specializing in furniture rental for both home and office environments, event furnishings, and a wide range of relocation and destination services. Founded in 1972 and headquartered in Chantilly, Virginia, CORT operates over 100 offices and showrooms across the United States and offers services in more than 80 countries through its CORT Global Network®.

The company provides flexible rental options for residential and commercial furniture, including corporate apartments and office spaces. CORT also supports event organizers with booth furnishings and display solutions for trade shows. Their comprehensive relocation services include apartment locating, employee relocation assistance, and home staging. CORT serves a diverse clientele, including the U.S. government, businesses, individuals, and event organizers, ensuring a smooth transition for those in need of temporary furnishings and support.

54ebad587468694311fd140c.organization_short_description:
Side, formerly known as PTW, is a global video game development and services company based in London, UK. Established in 2009, Side operates 20 studios across 14 countries, leveraging over 30 years of experience from its parent company in Japan. The company provides a wide range of services to game developers and publishers, including co-development, art production, audio production, quality assurance, localization, player support, and community management.

Side focuses on delivering technical and creative solutions that help gaming studios enhance production capabilities and improve game quality. Its offerings include specialized support infrastructure, such as player support systems and localization pipelines. As a B2B service provider, Side partners with major gaming companies worldwide, assisting them at all stages of production to prepare games for international markets and support players globally.

6490448274fde000011961ae.organization_short_description:
CORT is a leading provider of transition services, specializing in furniture rental for both home and office environments, event furnishings, and a wide range of relocation and destination services. Founded in 1972 and headquartered in Chantilly, Virginia, CORT operates over 100 offices and showrooms across the United States and offers services in more than 80 countries through its CORT Global Network®.

The company provides flexible rental options for residential and commercial furniture, including corporate apartments and office spaces. CORT also supports event organizers with booth furnishings and display solutions for trade shows. Their comprehensive relocation services include apartment locating, employee relocation assistance, and home staging. CORT serves a diverse clientele, including the U.S. government, businesses, individuals, and event organizers, ensuring a smooth transition for those in need of temporary furnishings and support.

613ae629e8010d000141ec47.organization_short_description:
Fluke Corporation is a prominent American manufacturer of electronic test, measurement, and diagnostic equipment, based in Everett, Washington. Established in 1948 by John Fluke, Sr., the company is recognized as a leader in electronic test tools and software, operating as a subsidiary of Fortive Corporation. Fluke employs around 4,162 people and has manufacturing centers in the USA, UK, Asia, and the Netherlands, with a presence in over 100 countries.

Fluke offers a wide range of products, including digital voltmeters, thermal imaging cameras, and network troubleshooting tools. Their tools are designed for various applications in industries such as manufacturing, medical, and IT. The company also provides calibration and maintenance services through its Fluke Calibration division, along with predictive maintenance solutions. Fluke's mission is to deliver reliable testing and troubleshooting capabilities, ensuring the quality and safety of critical equipment across multiple sectors.

5570ac15736964565d812600.organization_short_description:
CORT is a leading provider of transition services, specializing in furniture rental for both home and office environments, event furnishings, and a wide range of relocation and destination services. Founded in 1972 and headquartered in Chantilly, Virginia, CORT operates over 100 offices and showrooms across the United States and offers services in more than 80 countries through its CORT Global Network®.

The company provides flexible rental options for residential and commercial furniture, including corporate apartments and office spaces. CORT also supports event organizers with booth furnishings and display solutions for trade shows. Their comprehensive relocation services include apartment locating, employee relocation assistance, and home staging. CORT serves a diverse clientele, including the U.S. government, businesses, individuals, and event organizers, ensuring a smooth transition for those in need of temporary furnishings and support.

66f95c6f9901a20001ab3f69.organization_short_description:
Side, formerly known as PTW, is a global video game development and services company based in London, UK. Established in 2009, Side operates 20 studios across 14 countries, leveraging over 30 years of experience from its parent company in Japan. The company provides a wide range of services to game developers and publishers, including co-development, art production, audio production, quality assurance, localization, player support, and community management.

Side focuses on delivering technical and creative solutions that help gaming studios enhance production capabilities and improve game quality. Its offerings include specialized support infrastructure, such as player support systems and localization pipelines. As a B2B service provider, Side partners with major gaming companies worldwide, assisting them at all stages of production to prepare games for international markets and support players globally.

610b82f24640980001f35b90.organization_short_description:
CORT is a leading provider of transition services, specializing in furniture rental for both home and office environments, event furnishings, and a wide range of relocation and destination services. Founded in 1972 and headquartered in Chantilly, Virginia, CORT operates over 100 offices and showrooms across the United States and offers services in more than 80 countries through its CORT Global Network®.

The company provides flexible rental options for residential and commercial furniture, including corporate apartments and office spaces. CORT also supports event organizers with booth furnishings and display solutions for trade shows. Their comprehensive relocation services include apartment locating, employee relocation assistance, and home staging. CORT serves a diverse clientele, including the U.S. government, businesses, individuals, and event organizers, ensuring a smooth transition for those in need of temporary furnishings and support.

645963e86bbb54000152f5ea.organization_short_description:
Teledyne FLIR, formerly known as FLIR Systems Inc., is a global leader in thermal imaging and advanced sensing solutions. The company designs and manufactures a wide range of products, including thermal imaging cameras, night vision equipment, sensor systems, and machine vision cameras. Their offerings cater to various markets, including industrial, government, and commercial sectors.

Founded in 1978, FLIR has established itself as a pioneer in infrared imaging technology. The company operates from its headquarters in Wilsonville, Oregon, with additional facilities in major cities worldwide. FLIR's technologies are utilized by first responders, law enforcement, and government agencies, contributing to public safety and energy efficiency. With a market share exceeding 60% in infrared thermography, FLIR is recognized as the leading company in this field. The company is committed to enhancing situational awareness and supporting intelligent community initiatives through its innovative solutions.

68c3926c7373a600010ea80f.organization_short_description:
Optimas Solutions is a global manufacturer and distributor of fasteners and supply chain solutions, focusing on North and South America. The company integrates fastener manufacturing and distribution, ensuring inventory certainty, consistent quality, and a lower cost of ownership. Headquartered in Wood Dale, Illinois, Optimas Solutions has established itself as a leader in the industrial distribution sector, particularly for manufacturers seeking improved efficiency and profitability.

The company offers a wide range of products, including screws, washers, nuts, and other industrial components. Optimas also provides integrated manufacturing and distribution services, inventory management, engineering support, and quality services to enhance operational quality. Their online platform allows for easy ordering of parts, catering specifically to industrial OEMs, tier partners, and distributors. By managing supply chain complexities, Optimas Solutions helps its customers focus on their core manufacturing activities.

6107caaf801e4300015b82af.organization_short_description:
Bloom Energy is an American company founded in 2001 and based in San Jose, California. It specializes in designing and manufacturing solid oxide fuel cells (SOFCs) that generate reliable, on-site electricity without combustion. The company holds a significant share of the stationary fuel cell power generation market and serves a diverse range of customers, including Fortune 100 companies, across various sectors such as data centers, manufacturing, and healthcare.

The core offerings of Bloom Energy include the Bloom Energy Server, which provides continuous power by converting natural gas, biogas, or hydrogen into electricity through an electrochemical process. Additionally, the Bloom Electrolyzer produces hydrogen, and the company offers decentralized energy systems for baseload power and microgrids. Bloom Energy's technology is rooted in NASA's Mars program, emphasizing its commitment to delivering clean, distributed energy solutions to businesses and communities worldwide.

679e103ac87de50001833b0d.organization_short_description:
Bloom Energy is an American company founded in 2001 and based in San Jose, California. It specializes in designing and manufacturing solid oxide fuel cells (SOFCs) that generate reliable, on-site electricity without combustion. The company holds a significant share of the stationary fuel cell power generation market and serves a diverse range of customers, including Fortune 100 companies, across various sectors such as data centers, manufacturing, and healthcare.

The core offerings of Bloom Energy include the Bloom Energy Server, which provides continuous power by converting natural gas, biogas, or hydrogen into electricity through an electrochemical process. Additionally, the Bloom Electrolyzer produces hydrogen, and the company offers decentralized energy systems for baseload power and microgrids. Bloom Energy's technology is rooted in NASA's Mars program, emphasizing its commitment to delivering clean, distributed energy solutions to businesses and communities worldwide.

666016b6818ecd0001f6b0c1.organization_short_description:
Bloom Energy is an American company founded in 2001 and based in San Jose, California. It specializes in designing and manufacturing solid oxide fuel cells (SOFCs) that generate reliable, on-site electricity without combustion. The company holds a significant share of the stationary fuel cell power generation market and serves a diverse range of customers, including Fortune 100 companies, across various sectors such as data centers, manufacturing, and healthcare.

The core offerings of Bloom Energy include the Bloom Energy Server, which provides continuous power by converting natural gas, biogas, or hydrogen into electricity through an electrochemical process. Additionally, the Bloom Electrolyzer produces hydrogen, and the company offers decentralized energy systems for baseload power and microgrids. Bloom Energy's technology is rooted in NASA's Mars program, emphasizing its commitment to delivering clean, distributed energy solutions to businesses and communities worldwide.

66aafcb38dc15800011a419a.organization_short_description:
Bloom Energy is an American company founded in 2001 and based in San Jose, California. It specializes in designing and manufacturing solid oxide fuel cells (SOFCs) that generate reliable, on-site electricity without combustion. The company holds a significant share of the stationary fuel cell power generation market and serves a diverse range of customers, including Fortune 100 companies, across various sectors such as data centers, manufacturing, and healthcare.

The core offerings of Bloom Energy include the Bloom Energy Server, which provides continuous power by converting natural gas, biogas, or hydrogen into electricity through an electrochemical process. Additionally, the Bloom Electrolyzer produces hydrogen, and the company offers decentralized energy systems for baseload power and microgrids. Bloom Energy's technology is rooted in NASA's Mars program, emphasizing its commitment to delivering clean, distributed energy solutions to businesses and communities worldwide.

5fd288a6a7b865000174c902.organization_short_description:
RDO Equipment Co. is a family-owned machinery dealership based in Fargo, North Dakota, established in 1968. The company operates over 80 locations across the United States and has international partnerships in Africa, Australia, Mexico, and Ukraine. With an estimated annual revenue of $1.5 billion and around 1,703 employees, RDO is a significant player in the machinery manufacturing and industrial equipment sector.

RDO offers a wide range of products and services, including new and used equipment sales, machinery rentals, parts and aftersales support, financing options, and technology solutions like GPS and drone services. The company represents leading manufacturers such as John Deere, Vermeer, and Topcon, serving various industries including agriculture, construction, environmental, irrigation, positioning, surveying, and forestry. RDO's vision focuses on providing innovative solutions for customers while fostering a creative and entrepreneurial work environment.

66f3c9bc56db6f0001cc4dcf.organization_short_description:
Carpenter Technology Corporation is a leading producer and distributor of premium specialty alloys, including titanium alloys, powder metals, stainless steels, alloy steels, and tool steels.  Carpenter Technology's high-performance materials and advanced process solutions are an integral part of critical applications used within the aerospace, transportation, medical and energy markets, among other sectors.  

Building on its history of innovation, Carpenter's superalloy and titanium powder technologies support a range of next-generation products and manufacturing techniques, including additive manufacturing or 3D printing.  

Information about Carpenter can be found at www.carpentertechnology.com

66f7384be550440001b92b63.organization_short_description:
Carpenter Technology Corporation is a leading producer and distributor of premium specialty alloys, including titanium alloys, powder metals, stainless steels, alloy steels, and tool steels.  Carpenter Technology's high-performance materials and advanced process solutions are an integral part of critical applications used within the aerospace, transportation, medical and energy markets, among other sectors.  

Building on its history of innovation, Carpenter's superalloy and titanium powder technologies support a range of next-generation products and manufacturing techniques, including additive manufacturing or 3D printing.  

Information about Carpenter can be found at www.carpentertechnology.com

6112019d8eb9ea00016b6f45.organization_short_description:
Pierce Manufacturing Inc. is a prominent North American manufacturer of custom fire and rescue apparatus, based in Appleton, Wisconsin. Established in 1913, the company has grown to become the largest fire apparatus manufacturer in North America and a key player globally. As a subsidiary of Oshkosh Corporation since 1996, Pierce utilizes advanced manufacturing techniques to produce high-performance emergency vehicles.

The company offers a wide range of services, including custom vehicle design and engineering, foam system design, and innovative safety technology. Pierce is known for its commitment to operator safety, having introduced features like frontal airbags and the Side Roll Protection system. Their product lineup includes pumpers, aerials, rescue trucks, wildland trucks, and homeland security apparatus, all built by skilled craftsmen in the United States. With a diverse clientele that includes municipal fire departments and industrial fire brigades, Pierce Manufacturing has delivered nearly 40,000 trucks worldwide, reflecting its reputation for reliability and performance.

590d069c9d7968ae25e9ad79.organization_short_description:
UT Medical is the region's academic health system, dedicated to our mission to serve through healing, education and discovery. In 2025, we were honored to be named one of America's Best Employers for Company Culture by Forbes, a recognition that reflects the strength, integrity and compassion of our team.

We bring together compassionate, community-rooted care with leading expertise and advanced research to improve the lives of people in our community and across East Tennessee.

Our team members, physicians, nurses, educators and researchers work side by side guided by integrity, excellence and compassion. We care for today's needs while shaping tomorrow's breakthroughs. As an academic health system, we teach the next generation of caregivers, expand access through evidence-based innovation and support discovery that pushes medicine forward.

East Tennessee is our home. Our roots here are deep, and our commitment to this community is unwavering. We believe that curiosity leads to progress, collaboration strengthens care and stewardship ensures we use our resources wisely to support long-term health for all.

As UT Medical, we are building a healthier future. One guided by purpose, strengthened by expertise and driven by the belief that the best care doesn't just treat illness but transforms lives.

54a7071a7468696829ed7b0e.organization_short_description:
Johns Hopkins All Children's Hospital is a non-profit pediatric healthcare institution located in St. Petersburg, Florida. As the only pediatric hospital in the area affiliated with Johns Hopkins Medicine, it provides family-centered care to children from birth through adolescence. The hospital is recognized for its clinical excellence and innovative research, serving as a regional referral center for complex pediatric cases.

The hospital offers a wide range of pediatric services, including critical care, specialty care across over 30 disciplines, emergency services, surgical services, and rehabilitation. It also provides community health programs through outpatient clinics and specialty care centers. Additionally, the hospital supports families with educational resources, medical equipment, and various support programs. 

Johns Hopkins All Children's Hospital is dedicated to improving health outcomes for children and families, making it a vital resource in the community.

60ac2b70883979000193aa15.organization_short_description:
PING is a family-owned golf equipment manufacturer based in Phoenix, Arizona. Founded in 1959 by Karsten Solheim, the company began in his garage and has since become known for its innovative approach to golf club design. PING is recognized for its commitment to quality and engineering, with a mission to push the boundaries of technology while upholding values of integrity and employee well-being.

The company offers a comprehensive line of golf equipment, including metal woods, irons, wedges, and putters, as well as high-quality golf bags and apparel. PING's products cater to a wide range of golfers, from professionals on major tours to amateurs of all skill levels. The brand is particularly noted for its custom-fitting technology, which enhances the playing experience for golfers worldwide. PING distributes its equipment globally, reaching markets in Europe, South Africa, and the Middle East.

60bfff99822b010001b91084.organization_short_description:
The Mount Sinai Health System is a prominent non-profit hospital network based in New York City, established in September 2013 through the merger of Continuum Health Partners and The Mount Sinai Medical Center. It is one of the largest integrated health systems in New York State, comprising seven hospital campuses, the Icahn School of Medicine, the Mount Sinai Phillips School of Nursing, and over 400 outpatient practices, employing more than 48,000 staff.

Mount Sinai provides a wide range of inpatient and outpatient services, covering all medical and surgical specialties, including advanced oncology, cardiology, and orthopedics. The system is known for its community-based care and specialized centers, such as the Mount Sinai Kravis Children’s Hospital. It serves diverse communities across the five boroughs of New York City, Westchester County, Long Island, and Florida, focusing on both local and global populations. The organization is recognized for its commitment to compassionate patient care, education, and groundbreaking research.

66f809c8ae47ef000173b2e7.organization_short_description:
The Mount Sinai Health System is a prominent non-profit hospital network based in New York City, established in September 2013 through the merger of Continuum Health Partners and The Mount Sinai Medical Center. It is one of the largest integrated health systems in New York State, comprising seven hospital campuses, the Icahn School of Medicine, the Mount Sinai Phillips School of Nursing, and over 400 outpatient practices, employing more than 48,000 staff.

Mount Sinai provides a wide range of inpatient and outpatient services, covering all medical and surgical specialties, including advanced oncology, cardiology, and orthopedics. The system is known for its community-based care and specialized centers, such as the Mount Sinai Kravis Children’s Hospital. It serves diverse communities across the five boroughs of New York City, Westchester County, Long Island, and Florida, focusing on both local and global populations. 54ec22ea746869444c32e656.organization_short_description:
Optimas Solutions is a global manufacturer and distributor of fasteners and supply chain solutions, focusing on North and South America. The company integrates fastener manufacturing and distribution, ensuring inventory certainty, consistent quality, and a lower cost of ownership. Headquartered in Wood Dale, Illinois, Optimas Solutions has established itself as a leader in the industrial distribution sector, particularly for manufacturers seeking improved efficiency and profitability.

The company offers a wide range of products, including screws, washers, nuts, and other industrial components. Optimas also provides integrated manufacturing and distribution services, inventory management, engineering support, and quality services to enhance operational quality. Their online platform allows for easy ordering of parts, catering specifically to industrial OEMs, tier partners, and distributors. By managing supply chain complexities, Optimas Solutions helps its customers focus on their core manufacturing activities.

54c1ecfe7468697af779945e.organization_short_description:
The Mount Sinai Health System is a prominent non-profit hospital network based in New York City, established in September 2013 through the merger of Continuum Health Partners and The Mount Sinai Medical Center. It is one of the largest integrated health systems in New York State, comprising seven hospital campuses, the Icahn School of Medicine, the Mount Sinai Phillips School of Nursing, and over 400 outpatient practices, employing more than 48,000 staff.

Mount Sinai provides a wide range of inpatient and outpatient services, covering all medical and surgical specialties, including advanced oncology, cardiology, and orthopedics. The system is known for its community-based care and specialized centers, such as the Mount Sinai Kravis Children’s Hospital. It serves diverse communities across the five boroughs of New York City, Westchester County, Long Island, and Florida, focusing on both local and global populations. The organization is recognized for its commitment to compassionate patient care, education, and groundbreaking research.

5f8df6e964902500011b748a.organization_short_description:
Claritev is an independent and public healthcare technology, data and insights company making healthcare more transparent, fair and affordable for all. We work across the healthcare value chain to expose imbalanced and inefficient pricing practices. Led by deeply experienced analysts, negotiators and innovators, Claritev provides tech-enabled solutions and services fueled by proprietary data from over 40 years of experience. Today, along with machine learning and AI, we utilize a robust enterprise platform to deliver price transparency, improve payment accuracy, and drive more meaningful analytics and decision-making.

Through Claritev, providers are able to make data-enabled decisions to optimize their service offerings, market position and ultimately deliver high-quality care. Payors and third-party administrators can deliver greater flexibility and value to plan sponsors. Employers can drive cost-efficient benefit design and patients can finally afford the care they need. 

By focusing on customized solutions that that improve transparency, affordability and quality for all key players, we're igniting a more competitive marketplace — one that lowers overall costs while improving quality. Claritev brings the transparency our nation needs to see its way to a better healthcare system.

60f84e807439610001a0789d.organization_short_description:
The Mount Sinai Health System is a prominent non-profit hospital network based in New York City, established in September 2013 through the merger of Continuum Health Partners and The Mount Sinai Medical Center. It is one of the largest integrated health systems in New York State, comprising seven hospital campuses, the Icahn School of Medicine, the Mount Sinai Phillips School of Nursing, and over 400 outpatient practices, employing more than 48,000 staff.

Mount Sinai provides a wide range of inpatient and outpatient services, covering all medical and surgical specialties, including advanced oncology, cardiology, and orthopedics. The system is known for its community-based care and specialized centers, such as the Mount Sinai Kravis Children’s Hospital. It serves diverse communities across the five boroughs of New York City, Westchester County, Long Island, and Florida, focusing on both local and global populations. The organization is recognized for its commitment to compassionate patient care, education, and groundbreaking research.

6011d6595416bf00018e969e.organization_short_description:
Claritev is an independent and public healthcare technology, data and insights company making healthcare more transparent, fair and affordable for all. We work across the healthcare value chain to expose imbalanced and inefficient pricing practices. Led by deeply experienced analysts, negotiators and innovators, Claritev provides tech-enabled solutions and services fueled by proprietary data from over 40 years of experience. Today, along with machine learning and AI, we utilize a robust enterprise platform to deliver price transparency, improve payment accuracy, and drive more meaningful analytics and decision-making.

Through Claritev, providers are able to make data-enabled decisions to optimize their service offerings, market position and ultimately deliver high-quality care. Payors and third-party administrators can deliver greater flexibility and value to plan sponsors. Employers can drive cost-efficient benefit design and patients can finally afford the care they need. 

By focusing on customized solutions that that improve transparency, affordability and quality for all key players, we're igniting a more competitive marketplace — one that lowers overall costs while improving quality. Claritev brings the transparency our nation needs to see its way to a better healthcare system.

66cea98d89acfb0001c482e6.organization_short_description:
Irving Shipbuilding Inc. is a Canadian shipbuilder and in-service support provider, operating as a subsidiary of J.D. Irving Limited. Established in 1994, with roots tracing back to 1889, the company is headquartered in Halifax, Nova Scotia. It employs over 2,100 shipbuilders and is a key player in fulfilling the federal National Shipbuilding Strategy.

The company specializes in designing, building, and maintaining naval vessels, along with providing engineering and logistics support. Its primary facilities include the Halifax Shipyard, North America's largest under-roof shipbuilding facility, and the Marine Fabrication Shop in Dartmouth. Irving Shipbuilding is known for constructing the Royal Canadian Navy's River-Class Destroyers and Arctic and Offshore Patrol Ships, as well as modernizing Halifax-class frigates. Its customer base is entirely defense-related, primarily serving the Royal Canadian Navy and the Canadian Coast Guard.

61196591415f000001948537.organization_short_description:
Irving Shipbuilding Inc. is a Canadian shipbuilder and in-service support provider, operating as a subsidiary of J.D. Irving Limited. Established in 1994, with roots tracing back to 1889, the company is headquartered in Halifax, Nova Scotia. It employs over 2,100 shipbuilders and is a key player in fulfilling the federal National Shipbuilding Strategy.

The company specializes in designing, building, and maintaining naval vessels, along with providing engineering and logistics support. Its primary facilities include the Halifax Shipyard, North America's largest under-roof shipbuilding facility, and the Marine Fabrication Shop in Dartmouth. Irving Shipbuilding is known for constructing the Royal Canadian Navy's River-Class Destroyers and Arctic and Offshore Patrol Ships, as well as modernizing Halifax-class frigates. Its customer base is entirely defense-related, primarily serving the Royal Canadian Navy and the Canadian Coast Guard.

5e70a9149c41b30001d98740.organization_short_description:
Claritev is an independent and public healthcare technology, data and insights company making healthcare more transparent, fair and affordable for all. We work across the healthcare value chain to expose imbalanced and inefficient pricing practices. Led by deeply experienced analysts, negotiators and innovators, Claritev provides tech-enabled solutions and services fueled by proprietary data from over 40 years of experience. Today, along with machine learning and AI, we utilize a robust enterprise platform to deliver price transparency, improve payment accuracy, and drive more meaningful analytics and decision-making.

Through Claritev, providers are able to make data-enabled decisions to optimize their service offerings, market position and ultimately deliver high-quality care. Payors and third-party administrators can deliver greater flexibility and value to plan sponsors. Employers can drive cost-efficient benefit design and patients can finally afford the care they need. 

By focusing on customized solutions that that improve transparency, affordability and quality for all key players, we're igniting a more competitive marketplace — one that lowers overall costs while improving quality. Claritev brings the transparency our nation needs to see its way to a better healthcare system.

607e9fff27df130001ef2f38.organization_short_description:
Irving Shipbuilding Inc. is a Canadian shipbuilder and in-service support provider, operating as a subsidiary of J.D. Irving Limited. Established in 1994, with roots tracing back to 1889, the company is headquartered in Halifax, Nova Scotia. It employs over 2,100 shipbuilders and is a key player in fulfilling the federal National Shipbuilding Strategy.

The company specializes in designing, building, and maintaining naval vessels, along with providing engineering and logistics support. Its primary facilities include the Halifax Shipyard, North America's largest under-roof shipbuilding facility, and the Marine Fabrication Shop in Dartmouth. Irving Shipbuilding is known for constructing the Royal Canadian Navy's River-Class Destroyers and Arctic and Offshore Patrol Ships, as well as modernizing Halifax-class frigates. Its customer base is entirely defense-related, primarily serving the Royal Canadian Navy and the Canadian Coast Guard.

5ef24327b4877b0001fda232.organization_short_description:
Conair LLC, also known as Conair Corporation, is a prominent global designer, manufacturer, and marketer of personal care and small kitchen appliances. Founded in 1959 by Leandro Rizzuto and headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, the company started with hair rollers and dryers and has since expanded its product range significantly.

Conair offers a variety of products, including hair dryers, styling tools, cookware, and multifunctional kitchen appliances. Its well-known brands include Cuisinart, BaBylissPRO, Scünci, TRAVELSMART, Waring, and Conair. The company markets its products online and through major retail chains, reaching customers in over 120 countries across six continents. Conair serves both professional salon users and everyday consumers, providing quality solutions for personal care and kitchen needs. The company operates as a private entity and employs between 1,001 and 5,000 people.

612527362835b700014127fd.organization_short_description:
Conair LLC, also known as Conair Corporation, is a prominent global designer, manufacturer, and marketer of personal care and small kitchen appliances. Founded in 1959 by Leandro Rizzuto and headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, the company started with hair rollers and dryers and has since expanded its product range significantly.

Conair offers a variety of products, including hair dryers, styling tools, cookware, and multifunctional kitchen appliances. Its well-known brands include Cuisinart, BaBylissPRO, Scünci, TRAVELSMART, Waring, and Conair. The company markets its products online and through major retail chains, reaching customers in over 120 countries across six continents. Conair serves both professional salon users and everyday consumers, providing quality solutions for personal care and kitchen needs. The company operates as a private entity and employs between 1,001 and 5,000 people.

611ba6bc374de5000112c6cf.organization_short_description:
Pregis is a leading global provider of innovative protective packaging materials and systems. We design, develop, and deliver high-performance packaging solutions that protect products, improve operational efficiency, and create better brand experiences across consumer and industrial markets.

Our solutions can be found in virtually every industry from ecommerce and logistics to food, healthcare, and manufacturing. Supported by a comprehensive sales, technical service, and distribution network, Pregis partners with customers to solve their biggest packaging and fulfillment challenges.

With over 30 facilities across North America, manufacturing operations in Europe, and an expanding global footprint, Pregis continues to scale with the growing demand for smarter, more sustainable packaging solutions.

We're always looking for energetic, passionate people ready to make an impact. Opportunities span manufacturing, engineering, finance, sales, marketing, all united by a shared commitment to innovation and customer success.

We're dedicated to designing packaging that protects both products and the planet. Explore our sustainability initiatives and progress in our latest Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) Report: https://www.pregis.com/sustainable-packaging/2024-sustainability-report/

60296e1ffd925a0001fe1062.organization_short_description:
Pregis is a leading global provider of innovative protective packaging materials and systems. We design, develop, and deliver high-performance packaging solutions that protect products, improve operational efficiency, and create better brand experiences across consumer and industrial markets.

Our solutions can be found in virtually every industry from ecommerce and logistics to food, healthcare, and manufacturing. Supported by a comprehensive sales, technical service, and distribution network, Pregis partners with customers to solve their biggest packaging and fulfillment challenges.

With over 30 facilities across North America, manufacturing operations in Europe, and an expanding global footprint, Pregis continues to scale with the growing demand for smarter, more sustainable packaging solutions.

We're always looking for energetic, passionate people ready to make an impact. Opportunities span manufacturing, engineering, finance, sales, marketing, all united by a shared commitment to innovation and customer success.

We're dedicated to designing packaging that protects both products and the planet. Explore our sustainability initiatives and progress in our latest Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) Report: https://www.pregis.com/sustainable-packaging/2024-sustainability-report/

66703c7665f03f0001f81cc2.organization_short_description:
Conair LLC, also known as Conair Corporation, is a prominent global designer, manufacturer, and marketer of personal care and small kitchen appliances. Founded in 1959 by Leandro Rizzuto and headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, the company started with hair rollers and dryers and has since expanded its product range significantly.

Conair offers a variety of products, including hair dryers, styling tools, cookware, and multifunctional kitchen appliances. Its well-known brands include Cuisinart, BaBylissPRO, Scünci, TRAVELSMART, Waring, and Conair. The company markets its products online and through major retail chains, reaching customers in over 120 countries across six continents. Conair serves both professional salon users and everyday consumers, providing quality solutions for personal care and kitchen needs. The company operates as a private entity and employs between 1,001 and 5,000 people.

67acc00ac7c59000014097ac.organization_short_description:
Gillette Children's Specialty Healthcare is a non-profit pediatric hospital located in St. Paul, Minnesota. Founded in 1897, it was the first public hospital in the U.S. dedicated to children with disabilities. The hospital focuses on treating children and young adults with complex brain, bone, and movement conditions, serving over 25,000 patients annually from Minnesota, across the U.S., and internationally.

Gillette offers specialized clinical care for conditions such as cerebral palsy, epilepsy, and scoliosis, along with innovative medical and surgical interventions. The hospital has a comprehensive approach that includes pediatric orthopedics, rehabilitation, and neurosciences. It employs a large team of healthcare professionals and conducts clinical research to enhance care standards. With a network of outpatient clinics throughout Minnesota, Gillette is committed to providing accessible, high-quality care for its patients.

66fc8649f037a60001d064ec.organization_short_description:
Conair LLC, also known as Conair Corporation, is a prominent global designer, manufacturer, and marketer of personal care and small kitchen appliances. Founded in 1959 by Leandro Rizzuto and headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, the company started with hair rollers and dryers and has since expanded its product range significantly.

Conair offers a variety of products, including hair dryers, styling tools, cookware, and multifunctional kitchen appliances. Its well-known brands include Cuisinart, BaBylissPRO, Scünci, TRAVELSMART, Waring, and Conair. The company markets its products online and through major retail chains, reaching customers in over 120 countries across six continents. Conair serves both professional salon users and everyday consumers, providing quality solutions for personal care and kitchen needs. The company operates as a private entity and employs between 1,001 and 5,000 people.

60cb5cb1f16b96000142b4c0.organization_short_description:
Pregis is a leading global provider of innovative protective packaging materials and systems. We design, develop, and deliver high-performance packaging solutions that protect products, improve operational efficiency, and create better brand experiences across consumer and industrial markets.

Our solutions can be found in virtually every industry from ecommerce and logistics to food, healthcare, and manufacturing. Supported by a comprehensive sales, technical service, and distribution network, Pregis partners with customers to solve their biggest packaging and fulfillment challenges.

With over 30 facilities across North America, manufacturing operations in Europe, and an expanding global footprint, Pregis continues to scale with the growing demand for smarter, more sustainable packaging solutions.

We're always looking for energetic, passionate people ready to make an impact. Opportunities span manufacturing, engineering, finance, sales, marketing, all united by a shared commitment to innovation and customer success.

We're dedicated to designing packaging that protects both products and the planet. Explore our sustainability initiatives and progress in our latest Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) Report: https://www.pregis.com/sustainable-packaging/2024-sustainability-report/

66f79cb5d075000001eadf56.organization_short_description:
S&C Electric Company is a leading manufacturer and provider of advanced switching, protection, and control solutions for electric power systems. Founded in 1911 in Chicago, Illinois, the company has over a century of experience in enhancing the reliability and efficiency of electric power grids. With a global workforce of more than 3,500 employees, S&C operates extensive manufacturing and engineering facilities in the United States and has subsidiaries in Canada, the UK, Australia, China, and Mexico.

The company offers a wide range of services, including engineering consulting, microgrid solutions, grid automation, energy storage integration, and field services. S&C is known for its innovative products, such as high-voltage fuses, circuit interruption switches, and automation controls. They serve a diverse customer base, including electric utilities, commercial and industrial power users, renewable energy developers, and government entities. S&C Electric Company is committed to sustainability and innovation, focusing on renewable energy integration and smart grid technologies to support the global energy transition.

54a78e8c7468696de743d63f.organization_short_description:
S&C Electric Company is a leading manufacturer and provider of advanced switching, protection, and control solutions for electric power systems. Founded in 1911 in Chicago, Illinois, the company has over a century of experience in enhancing the reliability and efficiency of electric power grids. With a global workforce of more than 3,500 employees, S&C operates extensive manufacturing and engineering facilities in the United States and has subsidiaries in Canada, the UK, Australia, China, and Mexico.

The company offers a wide range of services, including engineering consulting, microgrid solutions, grid automation, energy storage integration, and field services. S&C is known for its innovative products, such as high-voltage fuses, circuit interruption switches, and automation controls. They serve a diverse customer base, including electric utilities, commercial and industrial power users, renewable energy developers, and government entities. S&C Electric Company is committed to sustainability and innovation, focusing on renewable energy integration and smart grid technologies to support the global energy transition.

57d68ee9a6da98548ad325f3.organization_short_description:
S&C Electric Company is a leading manufacturer and provider of advanced switching, protection, and control solutions for electric power systems. Founded in 1911 in Chicago, Illinois, the company has over a century of experience in enhancing the reliability and efficiency of electric power grids. With a global workforce of more than 3,500 employees, S&C operates extensive manufacturing and engineering facilities in the United States and has subsidiaries in Canada, the UK, Australia, China, and Mexico.

The company offers a wide range of services, including engineering consulting, microgrid solutions, grid automation, energy storage integration, and field services. S&C is known for its innovative products, such as high-voltage fuses, circuit interruption switches, and automation controls. They serve a diverse customer base, including electric utilities, commercial and industrial power users, renewable energy developers, and government entities. S&C Electric Company is committed to sustainability and innovation, focusing on renewable energy integration and smart grid technologies to support the global energy transition.

670d4e4c5c517300014ac333.organization_short_description:
Terumo Neuro is a global leader in neurovascular medical technology, focusing on innovative, minimally invasive catheter-based solutions. The company specializes in treating and preventing hemorrhagic and ischemic strokes, cerebral aneurysms, carotid artery disease, and neurovascular malformations. Founded in 1997 as MicroVention and acquired by Terumo Corporation in 2006, it rebranded to Terumo Neuro in September 2024 to align with its parent company.

Headquartered in Aliso Viejo, California, Terumo Neuro operates manufacturing facilities in California and Costa Rica. The company sells its products in over 70 countries, supported by a direct sales organization and strategic distribution partnerships. 6789184658c47700016c9c02.organization_short_description:
Terumo Neuro is a global leader in neurovascular medical technology, focusing on innovative, minimally invasive catheter-based solutions. The company specializes in treating and preventing hemorrhagic and ischemic strokes, cerebral aneurysms, carotid artery disease, and neurovascular malformations. Founded in 1997 as MicroVention and acquired by Terumo Corporation in 2006, it rebranded to Terumo Neuro in September 2024 to align with its parent company.

Headquartered in Aliso Viejo, California, Terumo Neuro operates manufacturing facilities in California and Costa Rica. The company sells its products in over 70 countries, supported by a direct sales organization and strategic distribution partnerships. With a workforce of approximately 1,001 to 5,000 employees, Terumo Neuro reported revenue of $501.4 million. Its product portfolio includes more than thirty devices designed to enhance patient outcomes in neurovascular treatments, emphasizing access solutions for healthcare professionals.

5f4f1d51c24a000001efce3d.organization_short_description:
S&C Electric Company is a leading manufacturer and provider of advanced switching, protection, and control solutions for electric power systems. Founded in 1911 in Chicago, Illinois, the company has over a century of experience in enhancing the reliability and efficiency of electric power grids. With a global workforce of more than 3,500 employees, S&C operates extensive manufacturing and engineering facilities in the United States and has subsidiaries in Canada, the UK, Australia, China, and Mexico.

The company offers a wide range of services, including engineering consulting, microgrid solutions, grid automation, energy storage integration, and field services. S&C is known for its innovative products, such as high-voltage fuses, circuit interruption switches, and automation controls. They serve a diverse customer base, including electric utilities, commercial and industrial power users, renewable energy developers, and government entities. S&C Electric Company is committed to sustainability and innovation, focusing on renewable energy integration and smart grid technologies to support the global energy transition.

58be9a4ff65125ed591ad649.organization_short_description:
Terumo Neuro is a global leader in neurovascular medical technology, focusing on innovative, minimally invasive catheter-based solutions. The company specializes in treating and preventing hemorrhagic and ischemic strokes, cerebral aneurysms, carotid artery disease, and neurovascular malformations. Founded in 1997 as MicroVention and acquired by Terumo Corporation in 2006, it rebranded to Terumo Neuro in September 2024 to align with its parent company.

Headquartered in Aliso Viejo, California, Terumo Neuro operates manufacturing facilities in California and Costa Rica. The company sells its products in over 70 countries, supported by a direct sales organization and strategic distribution partnerships. With a workforce of approximately 1,001 to 5,000 employees, Terumo Neuro reported revenue of $501.4 million. Its product portfolio includes more than thirty devices designed to enhance patient outcomes in neurovascular treatments, emphasizing access solutions for healthcare professionals.

5dd0b53ecb059c00011e4f3c.organization_short_description:
MACOM Technology Solutions Holdings, Inc. is a leading American developer and producer of high-performance semiconductor products. The company specializes in radio frequency (RF), microwave, millimeter-wave, and photonic devices, catering to the Telecommunications, Industrial and Defense, and Datacenter industries. Headquartered in Lowell, Massachusetts, MACOM has a rich history dating back to 1950 and operates globally with manufacturing and engineering facilities in North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia.

With a diverse portfolio of over 3,000 products across 40 product lines, MACOM serves more than 6,000 customers annually. Their offerings include integrated circuits, RF and microwave devices, millimeter-wave semiconductors, and optical components. These products are utilized in various applications, such as wireless backhaul radios, high-density networks, and radar systems. MACOM is committed to quality and reliability, holding certifications like IATF16949, ISO9001, and ISO14001.

69e39c2e7661b5000105a46d.organization_short_description:
MACOM Technology Solutions Holdings, Inc. is a leading American developer and producer of high-performance semiconductor products. The company specializes in radio frequency (RF), microwave, millimeter-wave, and photonic devices, catering to the Telecommunications, Industrial and Defense, and Datacenter industries. Headquartered in Lowell, Massachusetts, MACOM has a rich history dating back to 1950 and operates globally with manufacturing and engineering facilities in North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia.

With a diverse portfolio of over 3,000 products across 40 product lines, MACOM serves more than 6,000 customers annually. Their offerings include integrated circuits, RF and microwave devices, millimeter-wave semiconductors, and optical components. These products are utilized in various applications, such as wireless backhaul radios, high-density networks, and radar systems. MACOM is committed to quality and reliability, holding certifications like IATF16949, ISO9001, and ISO14001.

54a3b4f37468692fa290620c.organization_short_description:
Sea Mar Community Health Centers is a nonprofit organization based in Seattle, Washington, established in 1978. It is one of the largest Federally Qualified Health Centers in the United States, serving approximately 250,000 to 310,000 patients annually across 13 counties in western Washington. Sea Mar is dedicated to providing comprehensive health, human, housing, educational, and cultural services, with a focus on Latino, immigrant, farmworker, and other underserved populations.

The organization offers a wide range of integrated services, including primary medical care, dental care, behavioral health services, social and case management, food security programs, housing assistance, and educational initiatives. Sea Mar operates over 90 clinics and facilities, employing around 2,500 to 3,480 staff members committed to community care. Its mission emphasizes social justice and quality healthcare for all individuals, regardless of their background or ability to pay.

6106c68c3be301000187c1a5.organization_short_description:
MACOM Technology Solutions Holdings, Inc. is a leading American developer and producer of high-performance semiconductor products. The company specializes in radio frequency (RF), microwave, millimeter-wave, and photonic devices, catering to the Telecommunications, Industrial and Defense, and Datacenter industries. Headquartered in Lowell, Massachusetts, MACOM has a rich history dating back to 1950 and operates globally with manufacturing and engineering facilities in North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia.

With a diverse portfolio of over 3,000 products across 40 product lines, MACOM serves more than 6,000 customers annually. Their offerings include integrated circuits, RF and microwave devices, millimeter-wave semiconductors, and optical components. These products are utilized in various applications, such as wireless backhaul radios, high-density networks, and radar systems. MACOM is committed to quality and reliability, holding certifications like IATF16949, ISO9001, and ISO14001.

681b1fe38528ea0001dbecb4.organization_short_description:
Boston Globe Media is an independent media company based in Boston, Massachusetts, dedicated to delivering award-winning journalism to the New England region. With over 153 years of experience, it has evolved from a traditional newspaper into a multimedia hub, providing breaking news through both digital and print platforms. The company is the largest newsgathering organization in New England, with a strong presence in Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island, and Washington, D.C.

The company offers a diverse range of products and services, including The Boston Globe, a Pulitzer Prize-winning newspaper, and Boston.com, a leading digital news site. Other offerings include Globe Opinion for commentary and analysis, Boston Magazine for lifestyle and culture, and STAT, which focuses on healthcare news. Boston Globe Media also hosts live and virtual events, provides content marketing through Studio/B, and offers advertising solutions that connect brands with engaged audiences.
