66048f2c37ab040007a2d832.organization_short_description:
Boston Globe Media is an independent media company based in Boston, Massachusetts, dedicated to delivering award-winning journalism to the New England region. With over 153 years of experience, it has evolved from a traditional newspaper into a multimedia hub, providing breaking news through both digital and print platforms. The company is the largest newsgathering organization in New England, with a strong presence in Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island, and Washington, D.C.

The company offers a diverse range of products and services, including The Boston Globe, a Pulitzer Prize-winning newspaper, and Boston.com, a leading digital news site. Other offerings include Globe Opinion for commentary and analysis, Boston Magazine for lifestyle and culture, and STAT, which focuses on healthcare news. Boston Globe Media also hosts live and virtual events, provides content marketing through Studio/B, and offers advertising solutions that connect brands with engaged audiences.

656f363f706e6100012fbaea.organization_short_description:
MACOM Technology Solutions Holdings, Inc. is a leading American developer and producer of high-performance semiconductor products. The company specializes in radio frequency (RF), microwave, millimeter-wave, and photonic devices, catering to the Telecommunications, Industrial and Defense, and Datacenter industries. Headquartered in Lowell, Massachusetts, MACOM has a rich history dating back to 1950 and operates globally with manufacturing and engineering facilities in North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia.

With a diverse portfolio of over 3,000 products across 40 product lines, MACOM serves more than 6,000 customers annually. Their offerings include integrated circuits, RF and microwave devices, millimeter-wave semiconductors, and optical components. These products are utilized in various applications, such as wireless backhaul radios, high-density networks, and radar systems. MACOM is committed to quality and reliability, holding certifications like IATF16949, ISO9001, and ISO14001.

66f5999c16966100015920a4.organization_short_description:
IMI plc is a British engineering company based in Birmingham, specializing in fluid and motion control technologies. Founded in 1862, it has grown into a global leader with over 12,000 employees across more than 50 countries. The company is publicly listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

IMI plc offers a wide range of engineering services, including custom design, manufacturing, installation, and maintenance of fluid and motion control systems. Their product portfolio includes severe service valves, pneumatic and electric actuators, motion control systems, and thermal management solutions. The company serves various industries, such as process automation, industrial automation, climate control, life sciences, and transportation, focusing on precision, safety, and sustainability. IMI is committed to innovation and developing technologies that support sustainable practices and improve operational efficiency.

60f81d36993e030001ef5167.organization_short_description:
IMI plc is a British engineering company based in Birmingham, specializing in fluid and motion control technologies. Founded in 1862, it has grown into a global leader with over 12,000 employees across more than 50 countries. The company is publicly listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

IMI plc offers a wide range of engineering services, including custom design, manufacturing, installation, and maintenance of fluid and motion control systems. Their product portfolio includes severe service valves, pneumatic and electric actuators, motion control systems, and thermal management solutions. The company serves various industries, such as process automation, industrial automation, climate control, life sciences, and transportation, focusing on precision, safety, and sustainability. IMI is committed to innovation and developing technologies that support sustainable practices and improve operational efficiency.

54a6fe40746869705a5a540b.organization_short_description:
IMI plc is a British engineering company based in Birmingham, specializing in fluid and motion control technologies. Founded in 1862, it has grown into a global leader with over 12,000 employees across more than 50 countries. The company is publicly listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

IMI plc offers a wide range of engineering services, including custom design, manufacturing, installation, and maintenance of fluid and motion control systems. Their product portfolio includes severe service valves, pneumatic and electric actuators, motion control systems, and thermal management solutions. The company serves various industries, such as process automation, industrial automation, climate control, life sciences, and transportation, focusing on precision, safety, and sustainability. IMI is committed to innovation and developing technologies that support sustainable practices and improve operational efficiency.

54a5c2af746869367629bfa5.organization_short_description:
IMI plc is a British engineering company based in Birmingham, specializing in fluid and motion control technologies. Founded in 1862, it has grown into a global leader with over 12,000 employees across more than 50 countries. The company is publicly listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index.

IMI plc offers a wide range of engineering services, including custom design, manufacturing, installation, and maintenance of fluid and motion control systems. Their product portfolio includes severe service valves, pneumatic and electric actuators, motion control systems, and thermal management solutions. The company serves various industries, such as process automation, industrial automation, climate control, life sciences, and transportation, focusing on precision, safety, and sustainability. IMI is committed to innovation and developing technologies that support sustainable practices and improve operational efficiency.

60201c7e19ed060001033a63.organization_short_description:
Clemens Food Group is the fifth largest pork processor in the U.S. and a sixth-generation, family-owned business founded in 1895 in Hatfield, Pennsylvania. With over 5,000 team members, the company operates a vertically coordinated pork production system that includes hog farming, feed milling, processing, packaging, transportation, and logistics.

The company is dedicated to providing wholesome, sustainable food while emphasizing ethics, integrity, and stewardship. Clemens Food Group offers a wide range of quality pork products, including fresh cuts like baby back ribs and pork tenderloins, as well as packaged items such as hams, bacon, sausage, and deli meats. They serve a diverse clientele, including retail partners, foodservice operators, and food manufacturers, ensuring exceptional service and sustainable solutions for all customers.

6610ca698c119e0007104335.organization_short_description:
Established in 2004, Legacy Health LLC is a dedicated Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) provider with a global workforce of 5,000+ employees.

Our services span the entire revenue cycle from patient scheduling and insurance verification to medical billing, denial management, collections, and AR resolution. With proven experience across all 50 U.S. states, Washington, D.C., and Puerto Rico, Legacy Health helps healthcare providers improve cash flow, reduce errors, and lower staffing costs while ensuring full HIPAA compliance.

6115f69b5a039e0001f3d236.organization_short_description:
Clemens Food Group is the fifth largest pork processor in the U.S. and a sixth-generation, family-owned business founded in 1895 in Hatfield, Pennsylvania. With over 5,000 team members, the company operates a vertically coordinated pork production system that includes hog farming, feed milling, processing, packaging, transportation, and logistics.

The company is dedicated to providing wholesome, sustainable food while emphasizing ethics, integrity, and stewardship. Clemens Food Group offers a wide range of quality pork products, including fresh cuts like baby back ribs and pork tenderloins, as well as packaged items such as hams, bacon, sausage, and deli meats. They serve a diverse clientele, including retail partners, foodservice operators, and food manufacturers, ensuring exceptional service and sustainable solutions for all customers.

64fd2973322ace0001fb0495.organization_short_description:
Clemens Food Group is the fifth largest pork processor in the U.S. and a sixth-generation, family-owned business founded in 1895 in Hatfield, Pennsylvania. With over 5,000 team members, the company operates a vertically coordinated pork production system that includes hog farming, feed milling, processing, packaging, transportation, and logistics.

The company is dedicated to providing wholesome, sustainable food while emphasizing ethics, integrity, and stewardship. Clemens Food Group offers a wide range of quality pork products, including fresh cuts like baby back ribs and pork tenderloins, as well as packaged items such as hams, bacon, sausage, and deli meats. They serve a diverse clientele, including retail partners, foodservice operators, and food manufacturers, ensuring exceptional service and sustainable solutions for all customers.

611568692cef8700011649d9.organization_short_description:
Lactalis American Group is a U.S. subsidiary of Groupe Lactalis, the largest dairy products corporation in the world, based in Buffalo, New York. Founded in 1980, the company operates in the Food and Beverage Manufacturing industry and employs around 1,500 to 1,600 people across several locations in Idaho, Wisconsin, and New York State. Its mission is to connect people and enrich daily life through food.

The company specializes in a diverse range of dairy products, primarily cheeses and milk, under well-known brands such as Président®, Galbani®, Parmalat®, and Kraft Natural Cheese. Their cheese offerings include mozzarella, ricotta, provolone, brie, and feta, along with gourmet spreads and snack products. Lactalis American Group also provides UHT milk, butter, cream, and various ultra-fresh items like yogurts. The company serves multiple market segments, including culinary professionals, retail consumers, and food ingredient buyers, through its divisions like Lactalis Culinary and Lactalis Retail Dairy.

61156868adaf130001b6d135.organization_short_description:
Lactalis American Group is a U.S. subsidiary of Groupe Lactalis, the largest dairy products corporation in the world, based in Buffalo, New York. Founded in 1980, the company operates in the Food and Beverage Manufacturing industry and employs around 1,500 to 1,600 people across several locations in Idaho, Wisconsin, and New York State. Its mission is to connect people and enrich daily life through food.

The company specializes in a diverse range of dairy products, primarily cheeses and milk, under well-known brands such as Président®, Galbani®, Parmalat®, and Kraft Natural Cheese. Their cheese offerings include mozzarella, ricotta, provolone, brie, and feta, along with gourmet spreads and snack products. Lactalis American Group also provides UHT milk, butter, cream, and various ultra-fresh items like yogurts. The company serves multiple market segments, including culinary professionals, retail consumers, and food ingredient buyers, through its divisions like Lactalis Culinary and Lactalis Retail Dairy.

66f2bc7b6892900001d7b3df.organization_short_description:
Signant Health is a company focused on evidence generation, providing patient-centric software solutions for clinical trials. Founded in 2018 through the merger of CRF Health and Bracket, it combines over 20 years of expertise to support pharmaceutical companies, biotechs, and Contract Research Organizations (CROs) in designing and executing clinical trials. With headquarters in Blue Bell, Pennsylvania, and offices in several countries, Signant has contributed to approximately 25% of recent FDA and EMA drug approvals.

The company offers a comprehensive suite of eClinical solutions, including electronic clinical outcome assessments, eConsent platforms, randomization and trial supply management, and electronic data capture. Signant also provides scientific consulting services, patient engagement tools, and data quality analytics to enhance trial operations and data integrity. Its diverse client base includes over 600 pharmaceutical sponsors, CROs, biotech startups, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies, all benefiting from its innovative solutions to streamline clinical trials.

66fe11b37673080001e94dd8.organization_short_description:
Signant Health is a company focused on evidence generation, providing patient-centric software solutions for clinical trials. Founded in 2018 through the merger of CRF Health and Bracket, it combines over 20 years of expertise to support pharmaceutical companies, biotechs, and Contract Research Organizations (CROs) in designing and executing clinical trials. With headquarters in Blue Bell, Pennsylvania, and offices in several countries, Signant has contributed to approximately 25% of recent FDA and EMA drug approvals.

The company offers a comprehensive suite of eClinical solutions, including electronic clinical outcome assessments, eConsent platforms, randomization and trial supply management, and electronic data capture. Signant also provides scientific consulting services, patient engagement tools, and data quality analytics to enhance trial operations and data integrity. Its diverse client base includes over 600 pharmaceutical sponsors, CROs, biotech startups, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies, all benefiting from its innovative solutions to streamline clinical trials.

615332c9985a0c00019b57cf.organization_short_description:
Lactalis American Group is a U.S. subsidiary of Groupe Lactalis, the largest dairy products corporation in the world, based in Buffalo, New York. Founded in 1980, the company operates in the Food and Beverage Manufacturing industry and employs around 1,500 to 1,600 people across several locations in Idaho, Wisconsin, and New York State. Its mission is to connect people and enrich daily life through food.

The company specializes in a diverse range of dairy products, primarily cheeses and milk, under well-known brands such as Président®, Galbani®, Parmalat®, and Kraft Natural Cheese. Their cheese offerings include mozzarella, ricotta, provolone, brie, and feta, along with gourmet spreads and snack products. Lactalis American Group also provides UHT milk, butter, cream, and various ultra-fresh items like yogurts. The company serves multiple market segments, including culinary professionals, retail consumers, and food ingredient buyers, through its divisions like Lactalis Culinary and Lactalis Retail Dairy.

60f20f84f02d0500015c18d6.organization_short_description:
SMTC Corporation is a global provider of electronics manufacturing services (EMS), established in 1985 and based in Melbourne, Florida. The company specializes in delivering integrated contract manufacturing solutions that cover the entire electronic product life cycle, including product design, prototyping, manufacturing, systems integration, testing, and end-of-life support.

With a workforce of 1,001 to 5,000 employees, SMTC operates facilities across the United States, Canada, Mexico, and China. Their services encompass core manufacturing, engineering and design, supply chain management, and post-production support. SMTC serves a diverse range of industries, partnering with original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), emerging technology companies, and governmental entities in sectors such as aerospace and defense, medical devices, telecommunications, industrial IoT, and clean technology.

60c2a5410e1d3100019001bc.organization_short_description:
Signant Health is a company focused on evidence generation, providing patient-centric software solutions for clinical trials. Founded in 2018 through the merger of CRF Health and Bracket, it combines over 20 years of expertise to support pharmaceutical companies, biotechs, and Contract Research Organizations (CROs) in designing and executing clinical trials. With headquarters in Blue Bell, Pennsylvania, and offices in several countries, Signant has contributed to approximately 25% of recent FDA and EMA drug approvals.

The company offers a comprehensive suite of eClinical solutions, including electronic clinical outcome assessments, eConsent platforms, randomization and trial supply management, and electronic data capture. Signant also provides scientific consulting services, patient engagement tools, and data quality analytics to enhance trial operations and data integrity. Its diverse client base includes over 600 pharmaceutical sponsors, CROs, biotech startups, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies, all benefiting from its innovative solutions to streamline clinical trials.

68c7474b847824000116f6c7.organization_short_description:
General Dynamics NASSCO is a leading American shipbuilding and full-service shipyard based in San Diego, California. Founded in 1960, the company specializes in the design, construction, and repair of auxiliary, support, and commercial vessels. As the only full-service new-construction shipyard on the U.S. West Coast, NASSCO operates four facilities located in San Diego, Norfolk, Mayport, and Bremerton.

The company provides a range of maritime services, including ship repair and maintenance, ship conversions, and design and engineering. NASSCO is a Master Ship Repair contractor for the U.S. Navy, serving as a key repair facility for the Pacific Fleet. Its portfolio includes auxiliary vessels for the military, such as fleet replenishment oilers and logistics support ships, as well as commercial products like oil tankers and dry cargo carriers. NASSCO is recognized for producing efficient and environmentally friendly vessels, catering to both government and commercial markets.

66fb916ac2e81800011655cb.organization_short_description:
Signant Health is a company focused on evidence generation, providing patient-centric software solutions for clinical trials. Founded in 2018 through the merger of CRF Health and Bracket, it combines over 20 years of expertise to support pharmaceutical companies, biotechs, and Contract Research Organizations (CROs) in designing and executing clinical trials. With headquarters in Blue Bell, Pennsylvania, and offices in several countries, Signant has contributed to approximately 25% of recent FDA and EMA drug approvals.

The company offers a comprehensive suite of eClinical solutions, including electronic clinical outcome assessments, eConsent platforms, randomization and trial supply management, and electronic data capture. Signant also provides scientific consulting services, patient engagement tools, and data quality analytics to enhance trial operations and data integrity. Its diverse client base includes over 600 pharmaceutical sponsors, CROs, biotech startups, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies, all benefiting from its innovative solutions to streamline clinical trials.

66f44cdfbc3a8f0001c189f2.organization_short_description:
Nicklaus Children’s Health System is dedicated to providing comprehensive pediatric care exclusively for children from birth to age 21 in South Florida. Originally founded in 1950 as Miami Children’s Hospital, it was renamed in honor of the Nicklaus Children’s Health Care Foundation in 2015 and became Nicklaus Children’s Health System in 2017. The system serves a wide geographic area, including Martin County, Palm Beach County, and Miami-Dade, with over 800 attending physicians, including more than 500 pediatric subspecialists.

The health system offers a full range of pediatric services, including complex specialty care in areas such as neurology, orthopedics, and cardiac surgery, as well as primary and preventive care, outpatient services, and rehabilitation. Its flagship facility, Nicklaus Children’s Hospital, is the largest specialty children’s hospital in Florida and is recognized for its commitment to family-centered care. With a mission to inspire hope and promote lifelong health, Nicklaus Children’s Health System focuses on meeting the unique needs of children and their families throughout the region.

60dccc066ba93b0001aa38a4.organization_short_description:
Nicklaus Children’s Health System is dedicated to providing comprehensive pediatric care exclusively for children from birth to age 21 in South Florida. Originally founded in 1950 as Miami Children’s Hospital, it was renamed in honor of the Nicklaus Children’s Health Care Foundation in 2015 and became Nicklaus Children’s Health System in 2017. The system serves a wide geographic area, including Martin County, Palm Beach County, and Miami-Dade, with over 800 attending physicians, including more than 500 pediatric subspecialists.

The health system offers a full range of pediatric services, including complex specialty care in areas such as neurology, orthopedics, and cardiac surgery, as well as primary and preventive care, outpatient services, and rehabilitation. Its flagship facility, Nicklaus Children’s Hospital, is the largest specialty children’s hospital in Florida and is recognized for its commitment to family-centered care. With a mission to inspire hope and promote lifelong health, Nicklaus Children’s Health System focuses on meeting the unique needs of children and their families throughout the region.

60bfba5df82871000168839d.organization_short_description:
Universal Electronics Inc. (UEI) is a leading American provider of smart home technology and wireless universal control solutions, established in 1986. Headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, UEI operates globally with R&D offices in California and regional offices across Europe, Asia, and the Americas. The company employs over 4,100 people and manages multiple manufacturing and R&D facilities worldwide. UEI is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the ticker symbol UEIC.

UEI offers a wide range of products and services that enhance smart home interoperability and control. Their offerings include voice-enabled universal remote controls, smart home IoT devices, security sensors, and cloud platforms for device management. They also provide audio-video accessories and technology licensing for OEMs and private label customers. UEI partners with major brands like Comcast, Samsung, and Sony, serving various markets including consumer electronics, home automation, and security.

57d70cfca6da9805c5f19b68.organization_short_description:
Nicklaus Children’s Health System is dedicated to providing comprehensive pediatric care exclusively for children from birth to age 21 in South Florida. Originally founded in 1950 as Miami Children’s Hospital, it was renamed in honor of the Nicklaus Children’s Health Care Foundation in 2015 and became Nicklaus Children’s Health System in 2017. The system serves a wide geographic area, including Martin County, Palm Beach County, and Miami-Dade, with over 800 attending physicians, including more than 500 pediatric subspecialists.

The health system offers a full range of pediatric services, including complex specialty care in areas such as neurology, orthopedics, and cardiac surgery, as well as primary and preventive care, outpatient services, and rehabilitation. Its flagship facility, Nicklaus Children’s Hospital, is the largest specialty children’s hospital in Florida and is recognized for its commitment to family-centered care. With a mission to inspire hope and promote lifelong health, Nicklaus Children’s Health System focuses on meeting the unique needs of children and their families throughout the region.

66fb0f9add610a0001eb1308.organization_short_description:
SRC, Inc. is an independent, not-for-profit research and development company based in North Syracuse, New York. Founded in 1957, SRC focuses on addressing complex technological challenges in defense, environment, and intelligence sectors. With over 1,575 employees, including more than 1,000 engineers and scientists, the company is dedicated to delivering innovative solutions that enhance national security and environmental sustainability.

SRC offers a wide range of services, including advanced radar systems, electronic warfare solutions, secure communication networks, and environmental chemistry research. The company also specializes in risk assessment, simulation and training systems, and custom research and development programs. Its products include high-performance radar platforms, integrated electronic warfare suites, and precision environmental testing equipment. SRC serves a diverse clientele, including various branches of the U.S. military and government, as well as international allies and defense organizations.

66f42b11c559e7000122fe76.organization_short_description:
Universal Electronics Inc. (UEI) is a leading American provider of smart home technology and wireless universal control solutions, established in 1986. Headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, UEI operates globally with R&D offices in California and regional offices across Europe, Asia, and the Americas. The company employs over 4,100 people and manages multiple manufacturing and R&D facilities worldwide. UEI is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the ticker symbol UEIC.

UEI offers a wide range of products and services that enhance smart home interoperability and control. Their offerings include voice-enabled universal remote controls, smart home IoT devices, security sensors, and cloud platforms for device management. They also provide audio-video accessories and technology licensing for OEMs and private label customers. UEI partners with major brands like Comcast, Samsung, and Sony, serving various markets including consumer electronics, home automation, and security.

60941ba7c5ca2d00017f792d.organization_short_description:
3D Systems Corporation is a leader in additive manufacturing based in Rock Hill, South Carolina. Founded in 1986, the company engineers, manufactures, and sells a wide range of 3D printers, printing materials, and application engineering services. It operates a comprehensive digital manufacturing ecosystem that includes plastic and metal 3D printers, on-demand manufacturing services, and end-to-end manufacturing software.

The company serves various global markets, focusing on two main segments: Healthcare Solutions and Industrial Solutions. Its healthcare offerings include dental and medical devices, while the industrial segment covers aerospace, defense, and general manufacturing. 3D Systems provides a diverse portfolio of products, including advanced 3D printers, a variety of materials, and software tools for design and simulation. The company also offers custom parts services, maintenance, and training, collaborating with clients to enhance their manufacturing processes.

60d2e31834810e0001e2d13c.organization_short_description:
3D Systems Corporation is a leader in additive manufacturing based in Rock Hill, South Carolina. Founded in 1986, the company engineers, manufactures, and sells a wide range of 3D printers, printing materials, and application engineering services. It operates a comprehensive digital manufacturing ecosystem that includes plastic and metal 3D printers, on-demand manufacturing services, and end-to-end manufacturing software.

The company serves various global markets, focusing on two main segments: Healthcare Solutions and Industrial Solutions. Its healthcare offerings include dental and medical devices, while the industrial segment covers aerospace, defense, and general manufacturing. 3D Systems provides a diverse portfolio of products, including advanced 3D printers, a variety of materials, and software tools for design and simulation. The company also offers custom parts services, maintenance, and training, collaborating with clients to enhance their manufacturing processes.

54ec0147746869431169f23b.organization_short_description:
3D Systems Corporation is a leader in additive manufacturing based in Rock Hill, South Carolina. Founded in 1986, the company engineers, manufactures, and sells a wide range of 3D printers, printing materials, and application engineering services. It operates a comprehensive digital manufacturing ecosystem that includes plastic and metal 3D printers, on-demand manufacturing services, and end-to-end manufacturing software.

The company serves various global markets, focusing on two main segments: Healthcare Solutions and Industrial Solutions. Its healthcare offerings include dental and medical devices, while the industrial segment covers aerospace, defense, and general manufacturing. 3D Systems provides a diverse portfolio of products, including advanced 3D printers, a variety of materials, and software tools for design and simulation. The company also offers custom parts services, maintenance, and training, collaborating with clients to enhance their manufacturing processes.

60bb7c7614022c00014aab89.organization_short_description:
3D Systems Corporation is a leader in additive manufacturing based in Rock Hill, South Carolina. Founded in 1986, the company engineers, manufactures, and sells a wide range of 3D printers, printing materials, and application engineering services. It operates a comprehensive digital manufacturing ecosystem that includes plastic and metal 3D printers, on-demand manufacturing services, and end-to-end manufacturing software.

The company serves various global markets, focusing on two main segments: Healthcare Solutions and Industrial Solutions. Its healthcare offerings include dental and medical devices, while the industrial segment covers aerospace, defense, and general manufacturing. 3D Systems provides a diverse portfolio of products, including advanced 3D printers, a variety of materials, and software tools for design and simulation. The company also offers custom parts services, maintenance, and training, collaborating with clients to enhance their manufacturing processes.

5acc1c22a6da98c532f1b8b3.organization_short_description:
Akebono was founded over 90 years ago, and continues to provide the world's automotive industry with advanced braking and noise, vibration and harshness (NVH) solutions.

The company's commitment to innovation, process improvement, quality control and customer service has positioned it as a key resource for leading OEMs, Tier I brake suppliers and the automotive aftermarket. Key automotive OEM customers include Audi, Chrysler, Ford, General Motors, Honda, Isuzu, Mitsubishi, Nissan, Toyota and Volkswagen.

Akebono manufactures a wide range of brake friction materials and foundation brake assemblies, including disc brake calipers and drum brakes, employing the Akebono Production System (APS). This business approach features proven quality control techniques to guarantee minimal process variation in all phases of production. Embraced throughout the organization, APS enables the company to consistently achieve nearly zero defects per million parts produced.

Akebono operates R&D technical centers in the United States, Japan and France, and manufactures brake friction materials and components in 30 wholly owned or affiliated facilities worldwide. This includes four production facilities in Kentucky, Tennessee and South Carolina. All of Akebono's operations have secured appropriate QS9000 and ISO14001 certifications, and the company has received a number of quality and performance awards from customers.

Worldwide, a total of 8,279 people are employed by Akebono; 3,054 in North America. In 2012, the company's worldwide sales totaled $2.1 billion (US). North American sales totaled just over $1 billion (US).

Akebono has a proud legacy of achieving Japanese technological firsts. From its inception, Akebono initiated overseas technical tie-ups and offshore production.  All of these activities stem from the constant demands of improving quality and increasing customer satisfaction.

64c5f06f75662f0001aa5e9f.organization_short_description:
Pharmascience Inc. is a prominent Canadian pharmaceutical company based in Montreal, Quebec. Founded in 1983 by pharmacists Morris Goodman and Ted Wise, it has grown to become the largest pharmaceutical employer in Quebec, with around 1,500 employees. The company specializes in manufacturing and distributing a wide range of products, including generic, branded, and over-the-counter medications, as well as FDA-approved injectables. Pharmascience operates multiple production facilities in Montreal, Dorval, and Candiac, and distributes its products to over 50 countries.

The company offers a variety of pharmaceutical services, including contract research and development, manufacturing, and product analysis. Pharmascience produces more than 1,300 SKUs across various therapeutic categories, focusing on high-quality generic medications and innovative branded treatments. It serves a diverse customer base, including pharmaceutical wholesalers, hospitals, and pharmacists. Pharmascience is recognized for its commitment to quality and innovation, investing $40–$50 million annually in research and development.

610f5edd15ee4d0001e2ddf3.organization_short_description:
Roush is a global engineering and manufacturing company founded in 1976 by Jack Roush. Based in Livonia, Michigan, Roush specializes in automotive product development and high-performance components, serving various industries including mobility, aerospace, defense, agriculture, and entertainment. The company operates from 21 locations worldwide and employs between 1,001 and 5,000 people.

Roush Industries offers a wide range of engineering and development services, acting as a Tier 1 supplier. Their capabilities include vehicle assembly, concept design, body and chassis engineering, powertrain engineering, and vehicle integration. They also provide testing, prototype development, and manufacturing services. Roush produces high-performance automotive parts, engines for racing, and propane autogas fuel systems through its ROUSH CleanTech division. Additionally, they create custom vehicles and performance parts, supported by their installation center. Roush collaborates with a diverse clientele, including top racing competitors and organizations in defense, aerospace, and entertainment.

682a57a96e49b50001e9f927.organization_short_description:
Roush is a global engineering and manufacturing company founded in 1976 by Jack Roush. Based in Livonia, Michigan, Roush specializes in automotive product development and high-performance components, serving various industries including mobility, aerospace, defense, agriculture, and entertainment. The company operates from 21 locations worldwide and employs between 1,001 and 5,000 people.

Roush Industries offers a wide range of engineering and development services, acting as a Tier 1 supplier. Their capabilities include vehicle assembly, concept design, body and chassis engineering, powertrain engineering, and vehicle integration. They also provide testing, prototype development, and manufacturing services. Roush produces high-performance automotive parts, engines for racing, and propane autogas fuel systems through its ROUSH CleanTech division. Additionally, they create custom vehicles and performance parts, supported by their installation center. Roush collaborates with a diverse clientele, including top racing competitors and organizations in defense, aerospace, and entertainment.

60824f2262a9e40001286883.organization_short_description:
Pharmascience Inc. is a prominent Canadian pharmaceutical company based in Montreal, Quebec. Founded in 1983 by pharmacists Morris Goodman and Ted Wise, it has grown to become the largest pharmaceutical employer in Quebec, with around 1,500 employees. The company specializes in manufacturing and distributing a wide range of products, including generic, branded, and over-the-counter medications, as well as FDA-approved injectables. Pharmascience operates multiple production facilities in Montreal, Dorval, and Candiac, and distributes its products to over 50 countries.

The company offers a variety of pharmaceutical services, including contract research and development, manufacturing, and product analysis. Pharmascience produces more than 1,300 SKUs across various therapeutic categories, focusing on high-quality generic medications and innovative branded treatments. It serves a diverse customer base, including pharmaceutical wholesalers, hospitals, and pharmacists. Pharmascience is recognized for its commitment to quality and innovation, investing $40–$50 million annually in research and development.

61ead9534d22a7000166363d.organization_short_description:
Children's Hospital of The King's Daughters (CHKD) is a leading non-profit children's hospital located in Norfolk, Virginia. Established in 1961, it is Virginia's only full-service, freestanding children's hospital, dedicated to providing comprehensive medical and surgical care for infants, children, teens, and young adults up to age 21. CHKD operates as part of the CHKD Health System, which includes over 40 locations across southeastern Virginia and northeastern North Carolina.

CHKD offers a wide range of pediatric healthcare services, including acute care, specialty care, and community-based outpatient services. Its facilities include a Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU), Pediatric Intensive Care Unit (PICU), and a dedicated pediatric emergency department. The hospital is also known for its specialized programs in pediatric cancer, cardiac care, sports medicine, and mental health. With a commitment to promoting health and healing, CHKD serves a diverse population, ensuring access to quality care for all children in its service area.

6064aa3fba3d390001803d4d.organization_short_description:
WalkMe is a leading American software-as-a-service (SaaS) company specializing in Digital Adoption Platforms (DAP). Founded in 2011 in Tel Aviv and now headquartered in San Francisco, WalkMe has established itself as a pioneer in the DAP category. The company provides a cloud-based, AI-driven platform that enhances user interaction with enterprise technology through visual cues, step-by-step guidance, and personalized content.

WalkMe's platform features include interactive walkthroughs, on-screen guidance, task automation, and user behavior analytics. It is designed to support organizations using major enterprise applications like SAP, Salesforce, Workday, and ServiceNow. With a user base of approximately 35 million across 42 countries, WalkMe helps businesses improve employee onboarding, customer guidance, and overall software adoption, driving productivity and reducing support costs. The company operates as a wholly-owned subsidiary of SAP following its acquisition in September 2024.

60cd9f8599945f000122095c.organization_short_description:
Children's Hospital of The King's Daughters (CHKD) is a leading non-profit children's hospital located in Norfolk, Virginia. Established in 1961, it is Virginia's only full-service, freestanding children's hospital, dedicated to providing comprehensive medical and surgical care for infants, children, teens, and young adults up to age 21. CHKD operates as part of the CHKD Health System, which includes over 40 locations across southeastern Virginia and northeastern North Carolina.

CHKD offers a wide range of pediatric healthcare services, including acute care, specialty care, and community-based outpatient services. Its facilities include a Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU), Pediatric Intensive Care Unit (PICU), and a dedicated pediatric emergency department. The hospital is also known for its specialized programs in pediatric cancer, cardiac care, sports medicine, and mental health. With a commitment to promoting health and healing, CHKD serves a diverse population, ensuring access to quality care for all children in its service area.

62baeee672636f0001cadb06.organization_short_description:
Pharmascience Inc. is a prominent Canadian pharmaceutical company based in Montreal, Quebec. Founded in 1983 by pharmacists Morris Goodman and Ted Wise, it has grown to become the largest pharmaceutical employer in Quebec, with around 1,500 employees. The company specializes in manufacturing and distributing a wide range of products, including generic, branded, and over-the-counter medications, as well as FDA-approved injectables. Pharmascience operates multiple production facilities in Montreal, Dorval, and Candiac, and distributes its products to over 50 countries.

The company offers a variety of pharmaceutical services, including contract research and development, manufacturing, and product analysis. Pharmascience produces more than 1,300 SKUs across various therapeutic categories, focusing on high-quality generic medications and innovative branded treatments. It serves a diverse customer base, including pharmaceutical wholesalers, hospitals, and pharmacists. Pharmascience is recognized for its commitment to quality and innovation, investing $40–$50 million annually in research and development.
